title: Insurance Virtual Assistant
description:
Job Title: Insurance Operations Virtual Assistant (Workers’ Compensation)

Hours: 40 hours/week (Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST)

Flexibility: Up to 45 hours/week with prior approval

Industry: Payroll & Workers’ Compensation Insurance

Location: Remote (U.S. business hours)



Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Insurance Operations Virtual Assistant to support a fast-paced payroll

company with complex workers’ compensation insurance workflows. This role is hands-on and operational,

requiring prior insurance experience, deep familiarity with U.S. payroll processes, and excellent communication

skills.

The ideal candidate will take ownership of day-to-day insurance tasks, reduce operational bottlenecks, and

proactively manage audits, policy servicing, and internal coordination.



Key Responsibilities

• Process workers’ compensation insurance proposals, policy binding, endorsements, and renewals

• Manage workers’ comp audits, including documentation collection, payroll validation, and carrier

communication

• Coordinate closely with payroll teams to ensure accurate insurance reporting and compliance

• Use EZLynx (EZLinks) to manage quotes, submissions, and policy data

• Handle inbound and outbound communication with clients, carriers, and internal stakeholders

• Track deadlines, follow up on outstanding items, and proactively flag issues before they escalate

• Maintain clear documentation and follow established SOPs, while suggesting improvements when needed



Strict Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

Candidates must meet all of the following criteria:

• Hands-on experience with Workers’ Compensation Insurance

• Strong understanding of U.S. payroll processes, including payroll reporting and audit support

• Proven EZLynx (EZLinks) expertise

• Top-tier English accent suitable for frequent communication with U.S.-based clients and partners

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in the insurance industry (workers’ comp or closely related lines

preferred)



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with payroll companies or PEO environments

• Prior exposure to high-volume or audit-heavy insurance workflows

• Strong organizational and task-prioritization skills

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Comfortable in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments



Success Metrics (First 30–60 Days)

• Independently manages day-to-day insurance tasks with minimal follow-up

• Workers’ comp audits and policy servicing are handled accurately and on time

• Clear workflows and documentation are maintained and improved where needed

• Noticeable reduction in backlog and operational stress for internal teams

• Proactive communication—issues are flagged early with proposed solutions

- Updated CV

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
About Us

Zodiak Management is an Auckland-based short-term rental management company. We manage ~120 high-quality properties (Airbnb/executive rentals). We are profitable, stable, and entering a massive growth phase to expand into Wellington and Queenstown.



We are NOT looking for a Virtual Assistant. We are looking for a Head of Marketing to join our team remotely. You will be a department of one working with a contracted graphic designer, responsible for planning our growth strategy and overseeing the execution of the daily marketing work.



The Mission

We target Executive Property Owners (B2B) and High-End Travelers (B2C). Your main goal is to generate leads for new property owners and maintain a premium brand image.



What You Will Do (The Role)

- Strategy: Build the monthly marketing calendar. You tell us what campaigns we should run to enter new cities.

- Lead Generation (B2B): Manage LinkedIn outreach, cold
 sequences, and paid ads to find property investors.

- Content Writing: Write high-level, perfect English blogs and guides (e.g., "The ROI of Short-Term Rentals in Auckland").

- Social Media: Design luxury-style assets (Canva/Photoshop) and manage our Instagram/Facebook/LinkedIn to showcase our properties. This may be done by a graphic designer instead.

-
 Marketing: Manage our database and send monthly newsletters to owners and past guests.



Who You Are (Requirements)

- Native-Level English: You must be able to write sophisticated, nuanced English. Our clients are executives; slang or basic grammar errors are not acceptable.

- T-Shaped Marketer: You have broad experience (Social,
, Ads) but deep expertise in B2B Lead Gen.

- Proactive: You don't wait for tasks. You look at our business goals and suggest solutions.

- Tech Stack: Experience with Canva, GetResponse (or similair
 marketing tool), WebFlow, and Google Analytics.



Technical Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

- Reliable Fiber Internet (25Mbps+).

- Backup Power Source: You must have a generator or power station in case of brownouts.

- Noise-canceling headset and a quiet workspace.



What We Offer

- Competitive Salary: We pay above-market rates for top talent.

- Job Security: This is a long-term, full-time role.

- Autonomy: You will be the marketing leader, working directly with the company owners.

- Paid Time Off: NZ Holidays and sick leave.



How To Apply (Read Carefully)

- Applications that do not follow these instructions will be ignored.

- Please send your application with the subject line: "Zodiak Marketing - [Your Name]"

Inside the
/application, please include:

- A link to your Portfolio (specifically writing samples or social media accounts you have managed).

- A brief answer to this question: "If we wanted to attract a property investor who owns a $2M home, what is one marketing idea you would suggest?"

- A screenshot of your internet speed test.

title: Senior React Native Developer (Expo, Supabase, AI integrations)
description:
We're building Rovexa, an AI fitness app for iOS and Android. The website's live, the first features already run on real Supabase, and I'm pushing hard toward launch. This is our first senior engineering hire, and whoever does it well ends up leading the technology side as the company grows. We plan to grow quickly.



## What you'd work on



Workout tracking, nutrition logging with photo-to-calorie (a thousand apps already do this, we do the same), and the feature I care about most: an AI coach that remembers a user's training, sleep, food, and what they wrote in their journal, then coaches off all of it. 



Users are able to have voice-chats with the coach based on data they have entered (LLM or Text-to-speech API). App needs to have integrations with popular health apps (Apple Health, Android Health, Strava, Whoop etc.)



You'd own these end to end, backend to UI.



## You'd be a strong fit if you



- At least 3+ years of mobile app development experience

- Have shipped React Native / Expo apps in TypeScript

- Know Supabase properly: Postgres, Row Level Security, Storage, Edge Functions

- Write clean, modular code and are comfortable with Git branches and pull requests

- Have wired up LLM or vision APIs before (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude). Big plus, since the coach and the photo logging lean on it.

- Train/workout yourself *(optional)*. You don't need to be a competitive athlete, but if you understand what people want from a fitness app, it shows in what you build. This matters to us more than it might sound.



## Why take this role



It's early, so there's real ownership here and a clear path to leading the team as we hire. You'd work directly with me, ship quickly, and see your work reach real users soon. Pay is per milestone, scoped and agreed up front, and paid on time. Bonuses will be applied as well for exceptional performance.



Most likely a full-time role will follow for app maintenance and user requested features.



The founder has built other companies successfully already, so you will be working with someone knowledgeable. 



Job Type - Remote · contract to start, growing into a lead full-time role.





## To apply



Skip the cover letter. Just answer these three, briefly:



1. How would you build barcode food logging for this app? Walk me through the table and its Row Level Security, the screens, and a couple of edge cases. A short paragraph is plenty, and tell me one or two things you'd ask me before starting.

2. What's a feature you've shipped that used an AI or external API, and what was the tricky part?

3. Do you train? One line is fine.



If you're shortlisted, I'll send a small paid trial task. I pay for your time on that, always. If it goes well, we talk properly about the role.

s to prospective stockists and wholesale buyers

 and social media during the fresh fruit delivery period

General Admin & Content Support

Draft internal SOPs as processes are established



Systems & Documentation



Set up and maintain Asana as the primary task management tool

Document processes and build SOPs as tasks are locked in

Contribute to building workflows for this new arm of the business as it develops





What We're Looking For

Experience



Hands-on Shopify store management — non-negotiable; must be able to hit the ground running without guidance
 marketing experience in Klaviyo or a comparable e-commerce platform

Social media content creation and management across Instagram and

Direct-to-consumer or product-based e-commerce background

B2B outreach or sales support experience: building lists, writing outreach, following up

Customer service experience in an e-commerce or product business

Agriculture, food production, or premium food and beverage background: a genuine plus, not required



Technical Skills



Shopify — mandatory, high proficiency; product management, collections, apps, and reporting

Klaviyo — required; flows, campaigns, segmentation, and list building

Meta Business Suite — required; page management, scheduling, and analytics

Canva — proficient; able to create on-brand social graphics and marketing assets

Google Workspace — comfortable across Drive, Docs, Sheets, Meet, and Chat

Asana — comfortable or genuinely willing to learn; you'll set it up and own it

Meta Ads — nice-to-have; not required at the start but may be called upon down the track



Communication & Work Style



Strong written English across all contexts: product copy, captions, customer
s, and outreach

Proactive communicator — flags things early, asks the right clarifying questions before starting

Comfortable receiving direction by voice note and converting it into a clear task list without needing it repeated

title: Shopify SEO + AI-Search (GEO) Specialist - Ongoing Part-Time - Australian Store
description:
We run an established Australian Shopify store (11+ years, 2,000+ products) selling home distilling, brewing, and cheesemaking equipment. 



Our situation, so you know what you'd be working on:

- We already rank well, positions 2–7 for most of our main keywords. This is not a fix-the-basics job.

- But we've lost about 35% of our organic traffic and about 35% of organic revenue over the past year which is likely a mix of falling demand, Google's AI Overviews taking clicks, and lower click-through. We need someone to confirm the cause and grow from our existing strong position.

- On AI search: ChatGPT and similar recommend our competitors for general questions like “best home distilling kit,” while only mentioning us for specific named products. Closing this gap is a main goal.



Your work:

- Confirm why our organic traffic dropped using Google Search Console and GA4

- Work out why strong rankings aren't getting clicks (click-through rate, AI Overviews, search features)

- GEO: get us recommended in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, not just listed as a shop

- Optimise product and category pages across our six departments (titles, meta, copy, internal links)

- Technical SEO where it matters: indexing, page speed, schema

- Simple monthly report on what you did (by URL) and the results



Our existing setup:

We use the TinySEO app for image optimisation, schema, and redirects. Please work with it and tell us honestly if you'd change the setup. Keep an eye on page speed.



You must have:

- Real Shopify SEO experience, please send 2–3 live store links you've worked on

- Confident with Google Search Console and GA4

- Real experience improving click-through rate and AI-search visibility (not just rankings)

- Experience with schema / structured data, and good written English



To apply:

Please answer these (don't send a generic application):

1. We rank 2–7 for most keywords but lost about 35% of traffic and revenue this year, falling roughly together. What are the most likely causes, and how would you confirm which one is biggest?

2. AI assistants recommend our competitors for general “best kit” questions but only mention us for named products. How would you close that gap? Give specific tactics.



Shortlisted people will be paid for a 1-hour trial audit before we agree on ongoing work.



Hours: Part-time, ongoing. About 20–25 hours per week in the first month, then a steady ~15–20 hours per week (roughly 60–80 hours per month) ongoing. Long-term role for the right person.

title: Head of HR / Recruiter — 8-Figure Ecommerce Brand
description:
We are looking for a full-time Head of HR / Recruiter to build and manage the hiring engine for a fast-growing 8-figure ecommerce brand.

This role is a mix of recruiting, headhunting, hiring operations, HR administration, onboarding, and team-structure planning.

We are scaling quickly and need someone who can help us find strong talent, build consistent hiring pipelines, shortlist candidates, coordinate interviews, handle contracts/onboarding/payroll details, and help turn rough hiring ideas into clean role descriptions, workflows, and hiring processes.

This is not a passive HR role. We need someone proactive, organized, fast-moving, and extremely good at sourcing talent.

Main Responsibilities

You will be responsible for owning the hiring and HR operations process across the company.

This includes:

Building and managing hiring pipelines for current and future roles.

Poaching and sourcing strong candidates directly, especially through LinkedIn.

Creating and improving job posts, role descriptions, scorecards, interview questions, and hiring workflows.

Taking rough hiring “skeletons” from leadership and turning them into clear roles with responsibilities, must-haves, compensation structure, and interview process.

Shortlisting candidates and presenting the best options to leadership.

Coordinating interviews between candidates and internal tea
mbers.

Running first-round screening calls.

Fully managing interviews for smaller or more consistent roles such as customer support reps, video editors, graphic designers, and other execution roles.

Keeping open pipelines for rolling roles we are always hiring for, such as creative tea
mbers, editors, designers, CS reps, and operators.

Helping source higher-level roles such as CRO, retention, media buying, creative strategy, operations, finance, and leadership hires.

Managing candidate follow-ups, interview scheduling, rejection messages, offers, and onboarding communication.

Setting up contracts, NDAs, offer letters, and contractor agreements.

Collecting payroll details from new hires and coordinating payroll setup.

Managing onboarding for new tea
mbers so they know their role, tools, workflows, reporting structure, expectations, and first tasks.

Helping organize employee records, contracts, compensation details, and role documentation.

Helping coordinate the monthly all-staff meeting, including agenda preparation, reminders, attendance, and follow-up notes.

Working with leadership to define how teams should be structured, who reports to who, and how departments should work together.

Continuously improving our hiring process so we can move faster without lowering talent quality.

What You’ll Be Hiring For

You should be comfortable helping us hire across roles such as:

Customer support reps

Video editors

Graphic designers

Creative strategists

Media buyers

CRO operators

Retention managers

/SMS tea
mbers

Operations roles

Department leads

Specialist ecommerce operators

Some roles will be lower-level and repeatable. You should be able to manage those mostly yourself.

For higher-leverage roles, you will source, screen, shortlist, coordinate, and help leadership make the final decision.

Must-Have Skills

You must have:

Strong experience recruiting for ecommerce, agency, creative, performance marketing, or high-growth online businesses.

Expert-level ability to source and poach candidates directly.

Strong LinkedIn sourcing and outreach skills.

Ability to build hiring pipelines from scratch.

Ability to write clear job descriptions and role requirements.

Strong understanding of how to assess candidates beyond surface-level resumes.

Strong organization and follow-up.

Ability to manage multiple roles at once without losing track of candidates.

Strong communication skills with both candidates and internal tea
mbers.

Ability to work full-time and move quickly.

Ability to create systems, SOPs, workflows, and hiring documentation.

Comfort working with contractors, remote workers, international hires, and fast-moving teams.

Strong attention to detail around contracts, NDAs, payroll details, onboarding, and internal records.

Nice to Have

Experience hiring for 7–8 figure ecommerce brands.

Experience hiring creative strategists, editors, designers, media buyers, CRO, retention, or ecommerce operators.

Experience working inside a performance marketing agency, creative agency, or DTC brand.

Experience with ClickUp, Notion, Google Sheets, Slack, Loom, Gusto, Deel, Remote, or similar tools.

Existing network of ecommerce, creative, media buying, CRO, and operations talent.

Experience creating onboarding systems and team operating structures.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role if:

We have a consistent pipeline of strong candidates for key roles.

Leadership is no longer spending hours manually sourcing and coordinating candidates.

Smaller roles like CS reps, editors, and designers can be hired consistently without bottlenecking the founders.

High-level candidates are properly sourced, screened, and shortlisted.

Every role has a clear job description, scorecard, interview process, and hiring workflow.

New hires are onboarded smoothly and understand exactly what they are responsible for.

Contracts, NDAs, payroll details, and internal HR records are organized.

The company has a cleaner structure for teams, reporting lines, and workflows.

Hiring becomes a repeatable system rather than a chaotic one-off process.





How to Apply

Please send:

A short summary of your recruiting/HR experience.

The types of ecommerce, marketing, creative, or operational roles you have hired for.

Examples of roles where you directly sourced or poached candidates.

Your process for building a hiring pipeline from scratch.

Your availability and expected monthly compensation.

What You'll Be Doing

Invoicing & Accounts Receivable



Prepare and send invoices to builders and supervisors upon job completion

Follow up outstanding invoices and chase overdue payments as required

Mark invoices as paid in Base app and Xero once payment is confirmed

Maintain an accurate and up-to-date record of invoiced versus paid jobs at all times



Purchase Orders & RCTIs



Request purchase orders from builders and supervisors before work commences where required

Follow up any outstanding POs that haven't been received

Job Report Review (Base App)

Identify incomplete items, outstanding tasks, or notes flagged for return visits

Flag anything requiring attention clearly and promptly — don't let it sit

 & Inbox Management



Spend initial days learning the shared business inbox —
 types, supplier invoices, how responses are structured, the language the business uses

Manage and triage the inbox on an ongoing basis once you're across it

Respond to routine
s using established templates, escalating anything that needs a judgement call

Coordinate with the in-house admin to avoid duplication and ensure clean coverage



Administration & Record-Keeping



General filing and record-keeping across jobs and correspondence

Set up and maintain Asana for your own workflow tracking and recurring task management

Document SOPs using Fathom recordings as tasks are handed over — present each one back for sign-off before finalising

Leave clear handover notes on days when you and the in-house admin overlap — and on days when you don't



Daily Communication



Send a brief morning message via Teams when you log on each day with your priorities for the session

Send a daily end-of-day summary covering: what's been completed, what's in progress, and anything requiring attention or approval





What We're Looking For

Experience



Prior experience in admin, invoicing, or accounts-support — ideally within a trades, construction, or service business

End-to-end invoicing experience: preparing, sending, following up, and reconciling

Exposure to purchase order management and/or RCTI processes is a strong advantage

Experience supporting a busy small business owner in a fast-moving operational environment



Technical Skills



Xero — required; must be competent with invoicing, payment marking, and basic reconciliation

Base app — prior experience preferred; ServiceM8, simPRO, Tradify, or similar trades job management platform experience is directly transferable

Microsoft Teams — daily communication tool; must be comfortable with messaging and video calls

Asana (or similar) — able to set up and maintain your own task management; willing to learn if new

WhatsApp — used for mobile and backup communication

Fathom — used for recording SOP handover sessions and generating transcripts (download on day one)



Communication & Work Style



Communicates proactively — doesn't wait to be asked what's happening

Flags problems before they compound — if something looks off, says so

Works well around a busy owner who is unavailable at school drop-off/pick-up times — manages own priorities between check-ins without losing 
ntum

Collaborative with an existing in-house admin — clear on task ownership, leaves good handover notes, doesn't create overlap or gaps

Documents what they do as they go — doesn't wait for a "free day" to write things up





You'll Thrive Here If You Are…

Thorough by default — You don't skim. You review a job report the same way you'd want someone to review your own work. You know a small miss today creates a return trip tomorrow.

Reliable under routine — You treat daily invoicing, PO tracking, and inbox management as genuinely important work. Consistency is the job, not a stepping stone to something more interesting.

Proactively visible — You communicate progress without being asked. Morning message sent. End-of-day report done. Anything not moving flagged before it becomes a problem.

Detail-obsessed — You catch the PO that wasn't attached, the payment that wasn't marked off, the return visit note that wasn't actioned. That's exactly the kind of miss that matters most here.

A fast learner on platforms — You've picked up a trades job management system before (or something similar) and you know the logic transfers. You're not intimidated by a new tool.

Calm and independent — You work autonomously across your four hours without needing someone to check in on you. You manage your own priorities, ask questions when genuinely needed, and don't require direction to stay on track.

Commercially switched on — You understand that an unpaid invoice, a missed PO, or an unflagged defect isn't just an admin error. It affects cash flow, builder relationships, and the reputation the business has spent five years building.

title: Creator & Affiliate Partnerships Lead
description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for a Head of Creators who can take ownership of a creator and affiliate program that today operates as two separate engines   DTC/Shopify on one side, TikTok Shop affiliates on the other   and turn them into one performance-accountable function. You’ll create a network of external creators and affiliates across both platforms, with full ownership of strategy, negotiation, attribution, and revenue impact.

If you think in attributed GMV and creator ROI (not follower counts), if you’ve felt the drag of programs that hum without ever showing up in the P&L, and if you’re already running AI tools in your daily workflow keep reading.



ABOUT US

Decolure is a US-based e-commerce company generating $18M+ annually on Amazon, with expanding presence on TikTok Shop and DTC Shopify. We operate 5 private label brands with 20+ active products across the portfolio.

What makes us different: we're building one of the most data-driven operations in the private label space. Our team uses advanced analytics, AI-powered operational agents, custom data pipelines, and structured decision frameworks to manage every aspect of the business , from keyword-level PPC decisions to inventory forecasting to competitive intelligence. This isn't a company where you'll be making gut calls. Every decision is backed by data, and every action plan has measurable outcomes.

We're a 27-person distributed team across the world. We operate in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment where ownership and accountability matter more than hours logged.



THE ROLE

As Head of Creators, you’ll own the performance of the creator and affiliate program across DTC/Shopify and TikTok Shop. You’ll partner closely with brand management, paid media, Tiktok shop and the Dtc-Shopify Team on creative briefs and amplification, and with the Team lead on portfolio rollout sequencing.

This role directs creator and affiliate output. You do not personally produce content.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Creator & Affiliate Program Ownership (DTC + TikTok Shop)

Own end-to-end strategy for the creator and affiliate program across Shopify/DTC and TikTok Shop, with clear targets on attributed revenue, GMV, creator and affiliate ROI, content velocity, and paid amplification performance.

Build the creator and affiliate portfolio deliberately by tier, niche, audience, content style, conversion path, and channel fit. Not by adding bodies.

Personally manage high-value creator and affiliate relationships across both platforms   top performers, mid-tier creators, macro creators, TikTok Shop affiliates, and high-potential long-term partners.

Lead all negotiations: flat fee, performance-based, hybrid retainer, commission structures, TikTok Shop affiliate terms, usage rights, whitelisting rights, exclusivity.

Build the pipeline for new creator and affiliate discovery, outreach prioritization, qualification, onboarding, and performance review across both platforms.

Provide strategic oversight on the TikTok Shop affiliate side, ensuring alignment with the unified program even where day-to-day execution is operated separately.

Build the creator and affiliate brief library: angle, hook structure, product positioning, conversion path, success metric, deadline.



Cross-Platform Attribution & ROI

Build the unified attribution stack   UTM links, discount codes, affiliate tracking, TikTok Shop affiliate attribution, Shopify reporting, paid amplification lift   so true creator and affiliate ROI can be measured in one view.

Standardize contracts, usage rights, whitelisting permissions, content ownership terms, renewal logic, and performance incentives across both programs.

Build a monthly performance review covering creator and affiliate ROI, content performance, top hooks, best-performing formats, audience signals, platform-specific learnings, and recommended next actions.

Identify which creator and affiliate profiles produce outsized returns on each platform and which should be cut, reactivated, renegotiated, or scaled.



Whitelisting, Paid Amplification & Portfolio Rollout

Build and manage the whitelisting program for proven creator and affiliate content across DTC and TikTok Shop.

Partner with paid media to identify which creator and affiliate assets should be amplified across Meta, TikTok, and TikTok Shop ads. Track CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS, thumb-stop rate, hook performance, Shopify lift, and TikTok Shop conversion impact.

Document the unified playbook for portfolio rollout   tiering, briefs, attribution, contracts, KPIs   ready to apply to Sleephoria, Bamboo Reserve, and CooLinens within 6–12 months.

Direct AI-augmented operations: creator discovery, outreach personalization, hook generation, content scoring, attribution reporting, weekly performance audits.



QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

Required Experience

4-5 years scaling a creator, influencer, UGC, or affiliate program with measurable revenue impact at a $1M+/year Shopify-led DTC brand

Hands-on US TikTok Shop affiliate ecosystem experience   including affiliate recruitment, commission structure design, sample seeding, LIVE selling collaboration, Shop Plus / Affiliate Center workflows, and TikTok Shop performance optimization

Direct experience building or rebuilding cross-platform attribution   Shopify reporting + TikTok Shop affiliate tracking + paid amplification lift in one view

Demonstrated negotiation track record across flat fee, performance, hybrid, commission, and whitelisting deal structures

AI-native workflow   you already use AI for creator discovery, outreach personalization, hook generation, content scoring, reporting, or brief drafting in daily work. Not as exploration, as leverage.



Preferred Experience

Direct experience with premium bedding, sleep, wellness, or home textile brands 

TikTok LIVE selling experience as a strategic lever for affiliate engagement

Multi-brand portfolio creator strategy experience

 and lifecycle creator-content integration with measurable conversion lift

Whitelisting / dark-post paid amplification at scale (Meta dark posts, TikTok Spark Ads, similar)



WHO YOU ARE

You’re a strategic owner, not a coordinator. You take a creator program and own attributed revenue against it.You don’t deliver status updates; you deliver outcomes.

You judge content on conversion, not aesthetics. You can look at a hook and a first-three-seconds and predict whether it lands. You know the difference between portfolio-pretty and actually-converts.

You’re a systems builder. When you see a recurring problem, you don’t just dispatch   you fix it once with a process change that prevents the next occurrence. 

You’re AI-native, not AI-curious. You already use AI tools in your daily workflow and you treat them as leverage, not threat. Candidates who treat AI as “something the team is exploring” don’t fit.



WHAT YOU'LL GET

Competitive salary based on experience

Fully remote position. Work from anywhere

Advanced tooling and infrastructure, including AI-powered analytics, custom dashboards, and automated reporting that let you focus on strategy instead of data entry

A team that values data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement

Opportunities for growth as the company expands into new channels

Employee discounts on Inspiratek products

A team that values durable systems, data-backed decisions, and pushing creator economics forward.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your cover letter, CV, and portfolio to 
 using this subject line

Full Name - Country - Decolure Creator & Affiliate Partnership - Source

(e.g., Jane Doe - United States - Decolure Creator & Affiliate Partnership - LinkedIn)

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.

We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.

By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.

And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



This is not your typical Senior Financial Analyst role. You’ll work closely with our VP Finance and senior leadership team, helping to drive financial insight and discipline across one of Australia’s fastest growing companies.

You’ll play a key role in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting and business partnering, turning financial data into meaningful insights that support smart commercial decisions.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, ideal for someone who enjoys digging into the numbers, improving processes, and influencing business decisions.



You’ll be responsible for:



-Preparing monthly financial reports, dashboards and P&L analysis, including clear variance commentary

-Owning the budgeting and forecasting processes across multiple entities

-Building and maintaining financial models to support planning and decision-making

-Providing financial insights and analysis to support senior leadership and operational teams

-Partnering with State Leads and department heads to monitor performance and improve margins

-Assisting with reconciliations and financial data accuracy across systems

-Supporting compliance with BAS, PAYGW, FBT and other regulatory requirements

-Assisting with audit preparation and working with external auditors

-Identifying opportunities to improve financial processes and reporting efficiency

-Leading the implementation of automation, AI tools and improved reporting frameworks

-Report to Finance Manager and working closely with senior stakeholders



What will set you apart from other candidates:



-You’re analytical and commercially minded, able to turn data into meaningful insights

-You enjoy solving problems and improving processes

-You’re comfortable working in fast-paced, high-growth environments

-You’re highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities

-You take ownership and initiative, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement

-You’re curious and interested in leveraging technology and automation in finance



What you’ll bring:



-A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

-CPA, CA or CMA qualification (or working towards) highly regarded

-5+ years’ experience in financial analysis, reporting

-Strong experience with financial reporting, forecasting and variance analysis

-Advanced Excel / financial modelling skills

-Experience with Xero or similar accounting systems

-Strong communication skills and the ability to present financial insights clearly to non-finance stakeholders



What’s in it for you?



-This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!

title: Amazon PPC Rockstar: Scale Ads & Optimize TACOS
description:
Job Description: Amazon PPC Manager



Role Summary:

We are seeking an analytical, data-driven Amazon PPC Manager to take full ownership of our paid advertising strategies. Your core mission will be to scale our Amazon advertising revenue while optimizing for target TACOS (Total Advertising Cost of Sales) and ROAS (Return on Ad Spend). You will be responsible for campaign creation, keyword research, continuous bid optimization, budget management, and reporting directly to leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

* Campaign Strategy & Execution: Structure, launch, and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns to support both mature products and new product launches.

* Keyword & Competitor Research: Utilize tools like Helium 10 or Jungle Scout to identify high-converting keywords, discover back-end search term opportunities, and monitor competitor bidding strategies.

* Continuous Optimization: Perform weekly bid adjustments, match-type expansions, and aggressive negative keyword harvesting to reduce wasted ad spend.

* Budget & Target Management: Monitor daily spend to ensure campaigns do not run out of budget prematurely, keeping performance aligned with strict target ACOS/TACOS KPIs.

* A/B Testing & Creative Optimization: Plan and execute split tests for custom headlines, brand store pages, product imagery, and video ads to improve click-through (CTR) and conversion rates (CVR).

* Data Reporting & Insights: Provide weekly and monthly performance dashboards detailing ad spend, ad revenue, blended TACOS, and organic ranking trends.

Required Proficiencies & Experience:

* Proven track record (minimum 2+ years) of directly managing successful Amazon PPC campaigns with demonstrable results.

* Expert-level familiarity with Amazon’s advertising console, ad algorithms, and advanced match-type strategies.

* Highly proficient with e-commerce data tools: Excel/Google Sheets (pivots, lookups), Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or equivalent software.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to look at raw data trends and translate them into actionable operational strategies.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Technical & Workplace Requirements:

* Reliable, high-speed internet connection with a proven backup option (e.g., pocket Wi-Fi, secondary provider) in case of primary ISP failure.

* A dedicated, quiet workspace suitable for recording Loom videos and sharing screen-share updates.

* Highly organized with the ability to manage advertising budgets responsibly and hit weekly reporting deadlines without reminders.

Please submit your application with the subject line "PPC MASTER" so we know you have read this description completely. In your message, please share a brief summary of your Amazon advertising experience, your favorite keyword research strategy, and the average monthly ad spend you are used to managing. Applications without the specific subject line will not be reviewed.

If you're confident your static ads can convert and you're comfortable being measured on it, this is a great fit. If you're looking for a role where output is judged only on aesthetics, this isn't it.

What you'll do



Create static image ads for our products (sets, dresses, tops) based on clear creative briefs we provide

Work from a defined creative system — we'll give you our messaging framework (we use specific angles and tones, all documented in a guide you'll receive)

Turn raw photos and UGC stills into high-performing ad creative

Produce multiple concepts per week, with distinct visual hooks — not minor text swaps on the same layout

Iterate quickly on what's working



What we're looking for



Proven experience designing static ads for DTC/ecommerce brands (fashion, beauty, or similar a strong plus)

A portfolio of ad creative — but more importantly, examples of ads that performed, with context on results if you have it

Strong grasp of what makes a static ad stop the scroll and convert: hierarchy, hook, the first thing the eye lands on

Fast, reliable, communicative — hits deadlines and flags blockers early

Comfortable working to a brief and a defined creative system rather than freestyling



How this works



We start with a paid trial: you'll build a few image ads to our actual brief, and we may run one or two live to see how they perform

Clear expectations from day one — we'll tell you the performance bar before you start, so there's never ambiguity about what "working" looks like

Strong performers move into an ongoing role with consistent weekly work and a bonus structure tied to ad performance (ads that hit spend and ROAS targets earn bonuses)

Hours and weekly scope defined clearly up front



To apply



Share your portfolio, with emphasis on static ad creative for DTC brands

Tell us about one ad you made that performed well and why you think it worked

Note your experience with intimates/fashion brands if any

Confirm you're comfortable with a performance-based, trial-to-ongoing structure



We review fast and respond to strong applicants quickly. Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Ads manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Media Buyer to help grow a premium landscaping and pool construction company based in Sydney, Australia.



Our company specialises in high-end outdoor transformations for homeowners, including landscaping, pools, paving, and complete outdoor projects. We are not a budget company and we are not interested in cheap leads or low-quality enquiries.



Our goal is to attract serious homeowners who are willing to invest in premium outdoor spaces and quality workmanship.



We are looking for someone who understands how to generate both quality and quantity through strategic paid advertising while maintaining strong brand positioning and high-end marketing standards.



This is not a passive campaign management role. We are looking for someone highly engaged, performance-focused, proactive, and heavily involved in daily campaign optimisation and communication.



Responsibilities



* Set up, manage, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across:

    * Google Ads

    *
 & Instagram Ads

    * YouTube Ads

    * Pinterest Ads

* Generate both high-quality and high-volume leads

* Improve lead quality and overall campaign performance

* Research keywords, audiences, competitors, and targeting strategies

* Monitor budgets, conversions, ROAS, and campaign profitability

* Continuously test and scale successful campaigns

* Create and test:

    * Ad copy

    * Headlines

    * Offers

    * Landing page ideas

    * Audience targeting strategies

* Develop high-quality advertising creatives including:

    * Video ads

    * Image ads

    * Carousel ads

    * Retargeting creatives

    * Marketing concepts and hooks

* Submit all creatives and campaign concepts for approval before launch

* Set up and manage:

    * Conversion tracking

    * Retargeting campaigns

    * Meta Pixel

    * Google Analytics

    * Google Tag Manager

* Analyse campaign data and provide recommendations for improvement

* Deliver simple, clear performance reports and updates



Strategy & Research Expectations



* We are not looking for someone who simply launches ads and relies on platform AI to “figure it out”

* You must be able to perform proper market research, audience research, competitor analysis, and customer psychology research before launching campaigns

* We expect strategic thinking behind:

    * Target audiences

    * Ad angles

    * Creative direction

    * Offers

    * Messaging

    * Buyer intent

    * Landing page direction

* You should understand how to market to different customer types and income brackets, particularly homeowners investing in premium outdoor projects

* We are looking for someone who understands:

    * Consumer psychology

    * High-intent lead generation

    * Luxury positioning

    * Premium branding

    * Conversion strategy

* Campaigns should be backed by data, testing, research, and experience — not guesswork or random trial-and-error advertising

* We want someone who can bring ideas, strategy, insights, and recommendations to the table, not just manage ad accounts



What We’re Looking For



* Proven experience running paid advertising campaigns for:

    * Landscaping companies

    * Pool companies

    * Construction

    * Home improvement

    * Luxury/home service industries

* Strong experience with:

    * Google Ads

    * Meta Ads

    * YouTube Ads

    * Performance Max Campaigns

    * Remarketing Campaigns

* Understands the difference between lead quality vs lead quantity

* Knows how to attract high-intent clients, not just cheap leads

* Strong understanding of:

    * ROAS

    * CPL

    * CTR

    * Conversion optimisation

    * Funnel performance

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

* Excellent communication and reporting skills

* Highly responsive and proactive

* Able to work fast and adapt quickly



Important



* We prefer clean, premium-style marketing

* No “cheap”, “discount”, or aggressive sales-style ads

* We want someone who understands luxury and high-end branding

* We are not looking for generic or low-quality marketing

* We expect polished, professional-level creatives and advertisements that align with a premium brand

* No basic Canva, CapCut, or low-quality templated-style advertisements

* Creatives must look modern, refined, high-converting, and professionally produced

* You must understand premium marketing aesthetics and high-end advertising standards

* All creatives and campaign concepts must be submitted for approval before launch



Communication Expectations



* Daily check-in meetings will be required

* Strong communication is essential

* Fast response times and strong availability are expected, as communication and quick action are critical in this role

* When issues arise with campaigns, leads, creatives, or ads, we expect immediate communication and fast action

* We are looking for someone accountable, organised, and highly involved in the performance of campaigns



To Apply, Please Send:

* Portfolio or case studies

* Examples of campaigns you have managed

* Examples of ad creatives you have personally created

* Platforms you specialise in

* Internet speed test screenshot





We will begin with meta ads and then move onto both meta and google 



Salary is in AUD and negotiable based on performance

title: Customer Success Lead
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We’re hiring a Customer Success Lead to own post-sale customer outcomes for sales-assisted and high-value merchants.



You will help customers launch successfully, prove the system is working in production, resolve risks before they become major escalations, prepare for renewals, and expand into new states, categories, platforms, or workflows.



You’ll coordinate with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Growth. This is a player/coach role, so team guidance and process improvement may be part of the role, but direct reports are not guaranteed.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS AND IS NOT



This is not a basic CSM role focused mainly on check-ins and relationship maintenance.



This is not a reactive support queue role.



This role sits in the middle of customer outcomes, onboarding, compliance confidence, risk management, renewal readiness, expansion readiness, and internal coordination.



You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be comfortable using evidence, customer context, and structured follow-through to move complex accounts forward.



ABOUT TOKEN OF TRUST



Token of Trust helps regulated eCommerce businesses keep selling with confidence.



We help merchants launch compliant checkout, verify customers when required, reduce compliance risk, and manage the reporting and evidence they need to operate in regulated markets.



Customers have rated Token of Trust 4.9 stars on G2, and G2 recognized us among the 2026 Top 50 Data Privacy Products. We have also been recognized for Best Support, Easiest To Do Business With, High Performer, and Users Most Likely To Recommend.



Customer Success is a core part of why customers trust us. We are looking for someone who wants to help customers succeed while also improving the systems, playbooks, and processes behind that success.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Own the customer experience after sale: onboarding, launch, first proof of value, ongoing operations, renewal readiness, and expansion readiness

- Help customers launch compliant checkout with clear milestones, owners, risks, and next steps

- Help customers reach their first real proof of value in production, such as a successfully cleared customer, order, report, or compliance workflow

- Monitor customer risks such as verification issues, reporting problems, misconfiguration risk, unresolved blockers, or customer confusion

- Lead escalations by gathering evidence, isolating the problem, coordinating the right internal owners, and keeping customers updated

- Help customers understand and trust compliance calculations, reporting outputs, verification states, and operational workflows

- Prepare high-value accounts for renewal 60 to 90 days in advance by surfacing risks and driving issue-resolution plans

- Support customer expansion into new states, categories, platforms, or workflows

- Capture customer feedback clearly, ideally in the customer’s own words, and turn it into product feedback, internal tickets, or playbook improvements

- Improve onboarding playbooks, SOPs, help docs, and internal processes



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



You are successful when customers:



- Launch without unnecessary delays or rework

- Reach their first clear proof that Token of Trust is working for them

- Know whether their workflow is configured correctly because there is evidence, not just reassurance

- Avoid preventable surprises or unresolved escalations

- Enter renewals with known issues, owners, timelines, and a clear value story

- Feel that Token of Trust is organized, proactive, and clear



We care about support quality and customer sentiment, but this role is not measured mainly by ticket count, meeting count, logins, or generic activity metrics.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



For the right person, this is a real growth path, not just a customer-facing seat. As you prove judgement, ownership, and customer outcome discipline, you can earn more trust, broader responsibility, and increased compensation over time.



Possible growth paths include:



- Owning high-value customer onboarding and renewal readiness programs

- Building better proof-of-value playbooks for new customers

- Improving customer risk visibility and escalation prevention

- Creating customer health, renewal, and expansion workflows

- Guiding other tea
mbers through shared-account or playbook-driven Success work

- Becoming a deeper expert in regulated eCommerce customer outcomes



MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS



- 4+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Implementation, Solutions, Technical Account Management, or complex customer support

- Experience owning post-sale outcomes such as onboarding, go-live, risk management, renewal readiness, or expansion support

- Excellent written English

- Strong organization and follow-through

- Ability to manage multiple customer issues without losing details

- Good judgement in ambiguous, technical, regulated, or high-stakes situations

- Comfortable coordinating across Operations, Product, Engineering, and Growth without formal authority

- Able to diagnose issues clearly: what changed, what is the impact, what evidence exists, and what should happen next



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience in regulated eCommerce, identity verification, KYC, fraud, payments risk, tax, compliance reporting, or trust and safety

- Experience with Shopify, WooCommerce/WordPress, or headless eCommerce

- Basic understanding of webhooks, APIs, event logs, or technical troubleshooting

- Experience creating SOPs, playbooks, customer help docs, or internal process improvements

- Experience with shared-account or team-based customer success models



YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU



- Like complex products where correctness and evidence matter

- Can lead escalations calmly without overpromising

- Prefer customer outcomes over activity metrics

- Enjoy improving systems, not just answering questions

- Communicate clearly with both customers and internal teams



THIS MAY NOT BE A FIT IF YOU



- Want a simple reactive support role

- Prefer highly defined work with little ambiguity

- Dislike cross-functional coordination

- Rely mostly on meetings, logins, or ticket counts to measure customer success

- Struggle to keep many open customer issues organized



TOOLS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT



We use tools such as Amplitude, internal database reporting, FreeScout, Stripe, Pipedrive, G2, Shopify/WordPress ecosystems, shared docs, issue trackers, and internal playbooks.



You do not need experience with every tool, but you must be comfortable learning new systems quickly.



The work is remote, technical, compliance-heavy, and documentation-heavy. You’ll work with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Growth.



SCHEDULE



- Minimum 20 hours per week required

- Opportunity to expand to full-time, 40 hours per week, based on business needs, role fit, and performance

- Remote

- Meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours required

- Please include your timezone and preferred working hours when applying



COMPENSATION



This role starts at approximately $300 per month for a minimum schedule of 20 hours per week.



There is an opportunity to increase both hours and earnings over time. The role may expand to full-time, and strong performers may also qualify for monthly performance incentives.



Target total monthly earnings can increase to approximately $450 to $750 per month depending on hours, performance, role scope, and business needs.



Please include your expected monthly compensation in your application.



HOW TO APPLY



Use this subject line:



Customer Success Lead: I help customers prove value



Please send:



1) Resume or LinkedIn profile

2) Compensation and availability

   - Expected monthly compensation

   - Timezone

   - Preferred working hours

   - Amount of overlap you can provide with U.S. business hours

3) Customer ownership story

   In 5 to 8 sentences, describe one complex customer workflow, onboarding, renewal-risk, or escalation situation you owned end-to-end. Tell us what happened, what you did, how you knew whether the customer was getting value, and what changed as a result.

4) Process improvement example

   Briefly describe one playbook, SOP, customer health process, renewal process, or internal handoff you improved.

5) Short written exercise

   A customer says:

   “We turned this on and now good customers are getting stuck. We are worried this will hurt conversion.”

   Please answer:

   - What would you say in your first customer-facing reply?

   - What information would you gather internally?

   - Who would you involve internally and why?

   - How would you keep the customer updated over the next 48 to 72 hours?

6) AI usage note

   Tell us how you used AI, if at all, to complete this application:

   - Which sections did AI help with?

   - Where did you rely on your own judgment?

   - How did you verify the final answer reflected your actual experience and thinking?



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be reviewed.



HIRING PROCESS



After initial application review, selected candidates may be asked to confirm role requirements, compensation fit, long-term interest, no agency or subcontracting relationship, time-tracking expectations, background-check willingness, and integrity expectations.



Finalists may be asked to complete a short intro video and a paid trial project before final interviews.

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
Short-Form Video EditorShort-Form Video Editor



About Zylo



Zylo is an AI-powered video production agency. We produce short-form video content for two types of clients: ecommerce/DTC brands that need high-converting UGC-style ad content for Meta and TikTok, and local businesses that need social media content to promote their services and grow their online presence. We combine AI-generated footage with sharp editing and direct-response ad structure to deliver videos at volume - built to perform, not just look good.

The Role



We're looking for a fast, detail-oriented short-form video editor to help produce high-volume UGC-style video ads for ecommerce brands and local businesses. You'll take scripts, AI-generated footage, product assets, and creative direction, then turn them into polished vertical videos ready for Meta, TikTok, Reels, and client delivery.



What you'll do



-Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Meta ads, and YouTube Shorts

-Apply direct-response ad structure: hook, problem, product, benefit, proof, CTA

-Polish AI-generated footage - remove awkward timing, dead air, bad transitions, or unusable 
nts

-Export videos in 9:16, with clean naming and organized files

Bonus skills



-Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, 
, Google Drive, or Notion/ClickUp.

Ideal person



-A production-minded editor who moves fast, follows systems, has good taste, and understands that these videos are meant to perform, not just look pretty.

Operations Manager / Finance & Admin Coordinator

Summary

Location: Remote / Philippines-based

Contract Type: Independent Contractor

Experience: 5+ years operations, finance admin, vendor management, accounting support, or business administration

Commitment: 30 hours/week to start, with the possibility of increasing to 40 hours/week as business needs grow

Schedule: Monday to Friday, starting at 7:00 AM Pacific Time

Compensation: $12–$16/hour USD, depending on experience and qualifications

Bonus: Eligible for a discretionary annual contractor bonus after 12 months of continuous service, based on performance and company needs

Start Date: Immediate or as soon as possible



Synergy Wetsuits is a triathlon wetsuit, apparel, and accessories company based in Minden, Nevada, USA. We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager / Finance & Admin Coordinator to help keep our operations, finance admin, vendor agreements, compliance deadlines, and business records organized.

We need someone who can spot the missing invoice, expiring agreement, unfinished close item, or upcoming deadline before it becomes a fire drill.



About Synergy Wetsuits



Synergy Wetsuits designs and sells triathlon wetsuits, swim gear, apparel, and accessories for athletes around the world. We work with customers, retailers, events, vendors, factories, fulfillment teams, logistics partners, and business partners across the US, UK, Europe, and other markets.



We are a small, busy team, so this role requires someone organized, dependable, proactive, and comfortable working across departments.



Responsibilities



Operations Management

• Help manage daily business operations and admin workflows

• Track tasks, deadlines, deliverables, and open items across departments

• Coordinate with warehouse, fulfillment, logistics, product development, customer service, sales, marketing, and finance

• Follow up with vendors, suppliers, contractors, and tea
mbers

• Organize company documents, SOPs, trackers, reports, and shared folders

• Help improve processes and keep business records clean, current, and easy to access

• Support onboarding and admin setup for new tea
mbers

• Keep leadership aware of unresolved issues, upcoming deadlines, and operational gaps



Finance Admin & Monthly Bookkeeping Close

• Manage invoice approvals, payment schedules, and accounts payable follow-up

• Track bills, due dates, recurring charges, subscriptions, vendor fees, and service agreements

• Follow up on missing invoices, receipts, statements, vendor bills, and backup documents

• Coordinate monthly bookkeeping close with the bookkeeper

• Make sure invoices, payments, reconciliations, missing documents, and month-end reports are completed accurately and on time

• Organize financial records, bank statements, invoices, receipts, contracts, and supporting documents

• Work with the bookkeeper, accountant, tax preparer, and leadership team as needed

• Prepare reports, summaries, checklists, and trackers for leadership review



Vendor Agreements & Compliance

• Organize vendor agreements, contracts, pricing sheets, account documents, and renewal terms

• Track renewal dates, pricing terms, annual reviews, expiration dates, and contract deadlines

• Manage vendor records for FedEx, UPS, DHL, freight forwarders, 3PL partners, and other logistics vendors

• Make sure vendor contracts are reviewed at least annually

• Flag pricing changes, expiring agreements, outdated terms, and missing documents

• Maintain a tax and compliance filing calendar

• Track sales tax, VAT, business taxes, 1099s, annual reports, registrations, licenses, insurance documents, resale certificates, W-9s, and vendor forms

• Help make sure filings and renewals are completed regularly and on time



Executive Support for CEO

• Provide light business and personal admin support to the CEO

• Schedule meetings, calls, appointments, and travel when needed

• Track follow-ups, reminders, deadlines, and action items

• Organize key documents, contracts, records, and shared files

• Draft simple
s, updates, and internal messages

• Help with occasional remote personal admin tasks

• Handle confidential business, finance, and personal information with discretion



Must-Haves

• 5+ years of experience in operations management, finance admin, accounting support, vendor management, or business administration

• Experience working with US-based companies

• Strong understanding of bookkeeping workflows, accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, and payment tracking

• Experience coordinating monthly bookkeeping close with a bookkeeper, accountant, or finance team

• Experience with QuickBooks or similar accounting software

• Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills

• Ecommerce operations experience

• Experience with Shopify and Amazon Seller Central

• Experience with shipping carriers or logistics vendors such as FedEx, UPS, DHL, freight forwarders, or 3PL partners

• Experience organizing vendor agreements, service contracts, renewals, financial documents, and business records

• Experience with sales tax, VAT, 1099s, annual reports, registrations, or compliance tracking

• Strong written and spoken English communication skills

• Excellent attention to detail

• Highly organized, dependable, proactive, and trustworthy

• Available Monday to Friday starting at 7:00 AM Pacific Time

• Open to starting at 30 hours/week and increasing to 40 hours/week if business needs grow

• Reliable internet connection and computer setup



Nice-to-Haves

• Experience in apparel, sporting goods, logistics, ecommerce, or consumer products

• Experience with PayPal, Stripe, Airwallex, Wise, or other payment platforms

• Experience with Asana, Trello, Monday, ClickUp, or similar tools

• Experience creating SOPs, trackers, templates, or process documentation

• Interest in sports, triathlon, swimming, or fitness



Independent Contractor Terms



This is an independent contractor opportunity. The selected contractor will be engaged under a written contractor agreement and will submit invoices for services.

The contractor is responsible for their own taxes, government registrations, insurance, benefits, equipment, and compliance requirements in their country of residence.

The annual contractor bonus is discretionary and is not an employee benefit, statutory 13th-month pay, or guaranteed compensation.



Who We’re Looking For



We want someone who can become part of our core operations team — not just someone who waits for tasks.

The right person can think ahead, follow up without being reminded, catch problems early, protect confidential information, and turn messy details into clean systems.

This role is a good fit if you are organized, detail-oriented, calm under pressure, confident asking questions, and comfortable working with leadership, bookkeepers, accountants, vendors, logistics partners, and internal teams.



Who This Role Is Not For



This may not be the right fit if:



• You need constant step-by-step supervision

• You avoid follow-ups

• You are not comfortable working with financial or confidential information

• You prefer repetitive admin work only

• You are looking for a pure bookkeeping role

• You are looking for a pure executive assistant role

• You are not available to start at 7:00 AM Pacific Time



To Apply



 the following to

Applicant Questions

title: Amazon Logistics & Supply Chain Lead
description:
ABOUT US

Decolure is a US-based e-commerce company generating $18M+ annually on Amazon, with expanding presence on TikTok Shop and DTC Shopify. We operate 5 private label brands with 20+ active products across the portfolio.

What makes us different: we're building one of the most data-driven operations in the private label space. Our team uses advanced analytics, AI-powered operational agents, custom data pipelines, and structured decision frameworks to manage every aspect of the business , from keyword-level PPC decisions to inventory forecasting to competitive intelligence. This isn't a company where you'll be making gut calls. Every decision is backed by data, and every action plan has measurable outcomes.

We're a 27-person distributed team across the world. We operate in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment where ownership and accountability matter more than hours logged.



THE ROLE

This is one of our most critical hires. Our logistics department has more work than bandwidth, and we've learned through hard experience what this role needs. Two of our four strategic pillars — Supply Chain & Supplier Management and 3PL & FBA Operations — have minimal formal coverage today.

Here's the reality:

$30K+/month in Amazon storage fees, with LTSF as a compounding financial crisis needing systematic management

Supplier negotiation, freight optimization, and cost benchmarking remain unaddressed

Forecasting needs to mature from reactive to cross-functional — incorporating PPC, deals, channel data, and seasonal patterns

3PL strategy is nascent — needs formalization as a resilience layer

All China-based suppliers need consolidated relationship management

Without this hire, financial exposure continues to compound, lead times remain un-optimized, and the department cannot operate across all four pillars simultaneously.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Pillar 1: Inventory Intelligence & Demand Planning

Own days-of-supply (DOS) targets, safety stock methodology, and the forecasting process across all SKU tiers

Keep hero SKUs (60-80% of revenue) within target supply windows

Build cross-functional forecasting incorporating PPC spend, deals calendar, seasonal patterns, and channel-specific data

Own sell-through rate optimization across the portfolio

Pillar 2: Supply Chain & Supplier Management

Build this function from the ground up — your greenfield opportunity

Manage relationships with China-based suppliers across satin, bamboo, and cooling product lines

Establish the full PO lifecycle: issuance to production tracking to QC inspection to freight to receiving

Create supplier scorecards tracking lead time, defect rates, cost per unit, and responsiveness

Drive freight optimization and own COGS tracking end-to-end

Pillar 3: 3PL & FBA Operations

Define and track 3PL SLAs: processing time, storage costs, outbound accuracy, prep quality

Plan inbound shipments strategically to minimize placement fees

Build a reimbursement recovery process

Develop 3PL as a resilience buffer for demand spikes and supply chain disruption

Pillar 4: Cost Optimization & Storage Governance

Drive systematic fee mitigation across LTSF, SUR, shipping rates, and landed cost

Own the financial exposure dashboard

Build removal/liquidation ROI models

Make sure we NEVER get surprised by a cost cliff we should have seen coming

Pillar 5: Team Development & Process Formalization

Lead existing operators and grow the function

Document SOPs for ALL recurring processes

Establish cadences that run without prompting

Build a department that works even when you're not in the room



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 Days

Complete onboarding across all four pillars — map current state, tools, team, pain points

Present a 90-day action plan with prioritized initiatives and quick wins

Establish working relationships with each tea
mber

First 90 Days

Independently running weekly KPI cadence — CEO not required in the room

Supply Chain and 3PL pillars documented with first improvements underway

Storage fee exposure under systematic management

First supplier scorecard completed; freight optimization opportunities identified

By 6 Months

All four pillars staffed and operating with documented SOPs

Cross-functional forecasting process live

LTSF fees trending down month-over-month

By 12 Months

KPIs trending positively: DOS, storage fees, forecast accuracy, landed cost

Department absorbs demand fluctuations without crisis escalation

Leadership oversight shifted to monthly strategic reviews



WHAT WERE LOOKING FOR

Requirements:

Strong proficiency in written and spoken English

4-6+ years in logistics or supply chain roles, 2+ years owning outcomes in a leadership or senior IC capacity

Hands-on Amazon FBA experience — LTSF mechanics, SUR, inbound planning, placement fees, fee structures

Experience managing at least one 3PL relationship end-to-end

Track record of building processes from scratch in a resource-constrained environment

Experience managing or building a small logistics team (3-8 people)

Advanced Excel / Google Sheets fluency — you'll build models, dashboards, and trackers from day one

Financial acuity — you translate logistics decisions into dollar impact



Strong Preference

Experience with China-based suppliers and international ocean freight

Familiarity with FBA reimbursement processes

Experience scaling logistics for 100+ variations (color/size matrix)

Understanding of how PPC and promotional activity affect inventory planning



You’ll thrive here if you:

Treat the department’s financial exposure like it’s your own money—you don’t wait to be told something is a problem

Instinctively create repeatable processes rather than solving the same problem manually each time

Can look at a list of urgent items and pick the ones that actually matter this week, then communicate clearly about what’s being deferred and why

This Isn’t For You If

Your strength is strategy and frameworks but you’re not excited about personally pulling data and building spreadsheets—at least until the team grows

You need heavy top-down direction to know what to work on, or you need perfect information before you’re willing to make a call

Your experience is entirely in enterprise or Fortune 500 logistics without e-commerce or Amazon exposure

You see a small, early-stage team and think “that’s beneath me” rather than “that’s a chance to build something”



WHAT YOU'LL GET

Competitive salary based on experience

Fully remote position. Work from anywhere

Direct access to the CEO. Your ideas and analysis reach the decision-maker, not a middle manager

Advanced tooling and infrastructure, including AI-powered analytics, custom dashboards, and automated reporting that let you focus on strategy instead of data entry

A team that values data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement

Opportunities for growth as the company expands into new marketplaces and channels

Employee discounts on Decolure products



HOW TO APPLY

Send your cover letter and CV to 
 using this subject line format:

Full Name - Country - Logistics and Supply Chain Manager - Source

(e.g., Jane Doe - United States - Logistics and Supply Chain Manager - LinkedIn)



Also submit along with your cover letter a brief response (3–5 sentences) to the following question:

Describe a time you inherited a logistics or supply chain function with no documented processes and built the operating system from scratch. What did you prioritize first, and why?



Applications that do not follow this subject line format will not be processed.

EXPECTED PRODUCTIVITY

One completed supplier follow-up record is expected to average approximately 8–12 minutes, depending on supplier responsiveness, contact method, case complexity and quality of available PO / item information.



After onboarding, the normal operating target is:

- 35–45 completed supplier follow-up records per agent per day

- 70–90 completed records per day for a 2-agent team

- 350–450 completed records per week for a 2-agent team



A completed supplier follow-up record means a supplier contact attempt or response capture that is properly logged with supplier name, contact method, PO / item reference where available, response status, ETA or issue if available, next follow-up action and clear remarks. Quality, accuracy and proper logging are more important than volume alone.



REQUIREMENTS

- Good spoken and written English.

- Confident making business follow-up calls.

- Able to write clear and professional supplier follow-up
s.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Able to update Excel / Google Sheets trackers accurately.

- Reliable attendance and responsiveness during working hours.

- Able to follow structured instructions and daily priorities.

- Comfortable working with high-volume follow-up lists.

- Able to escalate unclear issues instead of guessing.

- Stable internet connection and working laptop / computer.

- Quiet working environment suitable for business calls.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Procurement support, purchasing assistant work, supplier follow-up, order expediting, logistics coordination, manufacturing support, BPO customer service, virtual assistant work with reporting duties, Excel / Google Sheets tracker management, order processing or supplier coordination.



TOOLS USED

Excel / Google Sheets,
, Cloud phone / softphone system, supplier follow-up tracker, daily reporting template, and communication tools such as WhatsApp, Teams or similar internal channels. Training and templates will be provided.



PAID TRIAL ARRANGEMENT

Selected candidates may be invited to complete a paid 5-day trial. The trial will assess attendance and responsiveness, supplier call and
 quality, accuracy of tracker updates, completeness of supplier follow-up records, ability to follow instructions, daily report submission, escalation discipline, and communication quality and reliability.



Trial payment will be processed after completion of the full 5 trial days and review of submitted daily work records / reports. Once completed and accepted, payment will be transferred to the candidate's designated bank account. Before the trial starts, we will send an engagement letter setting out the trial arrangement, working schedule, scope of work, payment amount, payment timing, confidentiality expectations and bank transfer process.



IMPORTANT SCOPE BOUNDARY

This role supports supplier follow-up and reporting only. It does not include supplier selection, price negotiation, purchase order approval, sourcing decisions, commercial decisions, payment decisions or direct representation of the customer. The agent supports ACN's managed supplier contact service and reports to ACN's internal service lead.



HOW TO APPLY

Please apply with the following:

- Your procurement, supplier follow-up, logistics, BPO or VA experience.

- Your experience making business calls or supplier follow-up calls.

- Your Excel / Google Sheets experience.

- Your internet speed and computer setup.

- Confirmation that you can work 8:00am – 6:00pm Singapore Time, with 1 hour unpaid lunch.

- A short sample message you would send to a supplier asking for delivery ETA and order status.
