title: Regulatory Compliance Officer
description:
Australian compliance advisory firm, remote, part-time (room to grow)



About ComplyEdge



ComplyEdge is a boutique regulatory compliance and risk advisory firm based in Sydney, Australia. We help businesses across financial services, fintech, lending, real estate and professional services understand their regulatory obligations, manage compliance risk, and respond to regulators with confidence. Our work spans regulatory advisory, AML/CTF and financial crime, employment and industrial relations compliance, breach and i
 response, ongoing managed compliance, and compliance health reviews.

We are growing, and I am looking for a reliable research and documentation assistant to support that work.



The role



You will help me with the research, analysis and document work that sits behind ComplyEdge’s advisory services. That means reading regulations and regulator guidance, turning them into clear summaries, and drafting compliance documents from templates and instructions. The work covers all of our service lines and every industry we support, so no two weeks look quite the same.

This is a support role. I review all client-facing work before it is used, so you are never carrying regulatory advice on your own. What I need is someone careful, accurate and good with words.



The details

 • Rate: AUD $5.00 per hour (approximately USD $3.30 per hour, depending on the exchange rate)

 • Hours: 15 hours per week to begin, with room to increase as we build a working rhythm and the workload grows

 • Around AUD $325 per month to start

 • Location: remote, Philippines-based independent contractor

 • Most work is asynchronous, though some overlap with Australian Eastern time for occasional check-ins is a plus



What you will do



 • Research Australian regulatory developments, legislation and official guidance from bodies such as AUSTRAC, ASIC, the ATO, Fair Work and the OAIC, and summarise what matters

 • Analyse regulatory obligations and turn dense material into clear, structured briefing notes and summaries

 • Draft and format compliance documents, including policies, procedures, registers, checklists, templates and reports, working from instructions and existing templates

 • Support work across all of ComplyEdge’s service lines: regulatory advisory, AML/CTF and financial crime, employment and IR compliance, regulatory response and breach management, managed compliance retainers, and regulatory health reviews

 • Help keep our internal knowledge organised by tracking regulatory changes and maintaining document libraries

 • Support compliance work across the industries we serve, including financial services, fintech, lending and credit, real estate, and professional services



How the work runs



A few things matter to me, so I want to be clear about them upfront.

 • You work under my direction, and I review client-facing output before it goes anywhere. You provide research and drafting support, not regulatory advice.

 • Accuracy comes first. I expect work grounded in primary and official sources, with anything uncertain flagged rather than guessed. On regulatory detail, asking a question is always better than making something up.

 • You will handle confidential, client-sensitive information, and I expect complete discretion.



What I am looking for



 • Strong written English. You can take a regulation or a guidance note and explain it clearly and correctly.

 • A background or real aptitude in compliance, law, regulation, audit, or a related field.

 • Genuine research skills and comfort reading legislation and official guidance.

 • Close attention to detail and a methodical way of working.

 • Reliability and the ability to manage your own time and hit deadlines without me chasing you.

 • Discretion with sensitive material.



Nice to have



 • Familiarity with Australian regulatory frameworks such as AML/CTF, ASIC and AFSL requirements, Fair Work, or the Privacy Act

 • Exposure to financial services, fintech or lending compliance

 • Experience drafting policies, procedures or compliance registers

 • Confidence with everyday document and spreadsheet tools



How to apply



Please send me:

 1. A short note (a few paragraphs) on your relevant experience and why this role suits you.

 2. A brief writing task, so I can see how you research and write. In around 200 words and in plain English, explain one thing an Australian business must do under a regulatory obligation of your choice. Name the source you used.

 3. Your weekly availability and any overlap you can offer with Australian Eastern time.

 4. Confirmation that the rate works for you.

Applications that skip the writing task will not be considered.



This role has room to grow for the right person. If you take regulatory accuracy seriously and you write well, I would like to hear from you.

title: AI Website Designer And Developer
description:
## Company: Atmospheric Thinking



## Position Type: Website Design & Development



## Department: Digital / Web Development



## Reports To: Project Manager & CEO



## Role Type: Internal Team Role



## Client-Facing: No phone or video calls required



## About the Role



Atmospheric Thinking is looking for an **AI Website Designer & Developer** to help build, update, and manage websites across multiple platforms and internal projects. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable using AI tools, modern website builders, and project management systems to move quickly while maintaining strong quality, organization, and communication.



This position will focus on building websites using platforms such as **Squarespace, Wix, Elementor, Webflow, Lovable, and other major website builders**. The ideal candidate should be highly adaptable, comfortable learning new tools, and able to manage a large number of projects at once.



A major part of this role will include using **Lovable daily** for both internal and external projects. The person in this position should be able to use AI-assisted development tools to create website pages, dashboards, landing pages, internal tools, client deliverables, prototypes, and other web-based assets.



This is not a client-facing role involving phone calls or video meetings. However, the role will still support client deliverables, including website updates, revision notes, report dashboards, draft
s, internal documentation, project updates, and other materials needed to support client work.



The team will also have **daily start-of-day calls** to review current tasks, priorities, blockers, deadlines, and project expectations.



## Key Responsibilities



### Website Design & Development



* Build, edit, and maintain websites using platforms such as Squarespace, Wix, Elementor, Webflow, Lovable, and other major website builders.

* Create websites, landing pages, service pages, location pages, blog layouts, forms, and basic conversion-focused page structures.

* Use AI tools to speed up website creation, content layout, wireframing, development, testing, and revisions.

* Work on both external client websites and internal Atmospheric Thinking projects.

* Use Lovable regularly to build web-based tools, dashboards, prototypes, internal systems, and client-facing digital assets.

* Translate project requirements into clean, functional, and visually organized website pages.

* Make website revisions based on internal notes, client feedback, QA reviews, and project manager instructions.

* Ensure websites are mobile-friendly, responsive, and easy to navigate.

* Follow brand guidelines, project instructions, and established design direction.



### AI & Tool Usage



* Use AI tools daily to assist with website development, content structuring, design support, troubleshooting, and workflow efficiency.

* Use Lovable on a regular basis for multiple internal and external projects.

* Stay comfortable experimenting with new AI tools, website builders, plugins, integrations, and development workflows.

* Use AI responsibly while still reviewing work for accuracy, design quality, and client readiness.

* Help improve internal processes for using AI in website design and development.



### Project Management & Organization



* Use ClickUp or similar project management systems to manage tasks, deadlines, notes, priorities, and updates.

* Handle a large caseload of website and development-related projects at one time.

* Keep project tasks organized and updated consistently.

* Provide clear written updates on project progress, blockers, completed work, pending items, and next steps.

* Attend daily start-of-day calls to review priorities and align on current responsibilities.

* Follow assigned timelines and communicate early when a deadline, task, or project requirement needs clarification.

* Balance multiple projects without losing track of details, feedback, or deliverables.



### Client Deliverable Support



Although this role is not client-facing through phone or video calls, it will involve preparing and supporting client deliverables such as:



* Website drafts and revision updates.

* Report dashboards.

* Internal and client-facing notes.

* Draft
s for project updates.

* Website QA notes.

* Revision summaries.

* Progress updates.

* Design and development documentation.

* Screenshots, walkthrough notes, or project summaries when needed.



### Quality Assurance



* Review websites for visual consistency, mobile responsiveness, broken links, formatting issues, missing content, and usability problems.

* Test forms, buttons, links, embedded elements, and basic user flows.

* Ensure completed work matches the assigned task instructions.

* Make sure website pages are polished before being submitted for internal review.

* Pay close attention to spacing, layout, readability, design consistency, and basic SEO structure.



## Required Skills & Experience



* Experience building websites using one or more major website builders such as Squarespace, Wix, Elementor, Webflow, Shopify, or similar platforms.

* Comfortable using AI tools to support website creation, development, project execution, and workflow improvements.

* Experience or strong willingness to use Lovable daily.

* Ability to learn new website platforms, AI tools, and internal systems quickly.

* Strong understanding of website structure, page layouts, responsive design, and user-friendly navigation.

* Ability to manage multiple projects at once while staying organized.

* Strong written communication skills.

* Ability to provide consistent updates without needing constant reminders.

* Comfortable working in ClickUp or another project management platform.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to follow instructions, revise work based on feedback, and meet deadlines.

* Comfortable working independently after receiving direction.



## Preferred Skills



* Experience with Elementor and WordPress.

* Experience with Webflow.

* Experience with Lovable or similar AI app-building tools.

* Basic understanding of SEO-friendly website structure.

* Basic understanding of landing page design and conversion-focused layouts.

* Experience creating dashboards, internal tools, or simple web apps.

* Basic HTML, CSS, or JavaScript knowledge is a plus but not required.

* Experience working for a digital agency, marketing agency, web design company, or similar environment.

* Familiarity with tools such as Canva, Figma, Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp, ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI platforms.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys building websites, learning new tools, and using AI to move faster without sacrificing quality. They should be highly organized, comfortable juggling multiple projects, and able to provide consistent project updates.



This person does not need to be on client calls, but they should understand that their work directly supports client deliverables. They should be able to take direction, work through revisions, and help bring website projects from idea to completion.



They should also be comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities may shift, multiple projects may be active at once, and daily communication is important.



## Daily Expectations



* Attend daily start-of-day calls to review priorities and current tasks.

* Check ClickUp or the assigned project management system regularly.

* Update tasks with progress, blockers, and completed work.

* Work on multiple website design and development tasks throughout the day.

* Use Lovable and other AI tools consistently.

* Complete assigned website updates, builds, revisions, dashboards, notes, and internal deliverables.

* Communicate clearly when something is completed, delayed, blocked, or needs review.



## Success in This Role Looks Like



* Website projects are completed accurately and on time.

* ClickUp tasks are consistently updated.

* Internal tea
mbers always know the status of assigned projects.

* Lovable and AI tools are used effectively to speed up development.

* The person can manage multiple projects without losing track of details.

* Website revisions are handled quickly and carefully.

* Client deliverables are organized, professional, and ready for review.

* Daily communication is clear, reliable, and helpful.

* Work quality improves over time as the person learns Atmospheric Thinking’s systems and expectations.

title: Reverse Recruiter (Virtual) — Drive My Job Search (Proactive | English-Speaking | Tech-Savvy | AI-Fluent)
description:
About the role



I'm looking for a highly motivated, detail-obsessed, and assertive Reverse Recruiter to manage my job search end-to-end. This is not a passive role. I need someone who takes ownership, drives the process, and holds me accountable — not the other way around. If I go quiet, follow up. If a deadline is approaching, flag it. If there's a better way to do something, bring it to me with a solution, not a question.



You'll research opportunities, tailor application materials, submit on my behalf, and keep everything meticulously organized — operating largely independently, without hand-holding.



What you'll do

- Search relevant job listings daily across LinkedIn, Indeed, ZipRecruiter, Monster, Glassdoor, company career pages, and any other high-yield sources you identify

- Tailor my resume and cover letter to each job description — thoughtful customization, not find-and-replace

- Submit applications through portals or
 on my behalf — complete, accurate, and polished every time

- Maintain a detailed application tracker in Google Sheets (company, role, date applied, link, status, follow-up actions)

- Proactively follow up on submitted applications at appropriate intervals, without being asked

- Flag interview requests, recruiter messages, or any responses immediately — don't wait for a check-in

- Remind me of actions on my end, and follow up if I'm slow to respond

- Continuously identify ways to improve the process and bring them forward



Work style — non-negotiable

- You're a self-starter who doesn't wait to be told what to do next. You anticipate needs, solve problems before they become problems, and keep things moving at all times. You're organized to a fault, proactive by default, and comfortable holding a client accountable: if something's overdue, you say so; if something could be done better, you say so. I want someone who's on top of this at all times — not someone I have to chase.



Experience

- Demonstrated experience managing job searches and submitting applications on behalf of clients

- A track record of success — clients who received interviews, offers, or landed roles as a result of your work

- Prior experience with clients in the technology sector (software, product, data, IT) is a strong plus

Technical skills

AI proficiency — highly valued

- Claude (Anthropic) — highest preference; specific familiarity with Claude is a meaningful advantage

title: SEO & AI Search Optimization Specialist
description:
# Job Title: SEO & AI Search Optimization Specialist



## Company: Atmospheric Thinking



## Position Type: SEO / Digital Marketing



## Department: SEO & Organic Growth



## Reports To: SEO Manager / Project Manager / Operations Lead



## Role Type: Internal Team Role



## Client-Facing: No phone or video calls required



## About the Role



Atmospheric Thinking is looking for an **SEO & AI Search Optimization Specialist** to support client and internal SEO projects across technical SEO, keyword research, backlink analysis, content optimization, analytics, reporting, and emerging AI search strategies.



This role is ideal for someone who understands both traditional SEO and the newer ways people are discovering businesses through AI-powered search tools, generative search engines, answer engines, and AI assistants. The ideal candidate should be comfortable using major SEO tools, analyzing website performance, identifying ranking opportunities, preparing deliverables, and keeping projects organized across a large caseload.



This is not a client-facing role involving phone calls or video meetings. However, the role will still support client deliverables, including SEO reports, dashboards, revision notes, draft
s, keyword research documents, audit summaries, backlink notes, implementation recommendations, and other project materials.



The team will also have **daily start-of-day calls** to review current tasks, priorities, blockers, deadlines, and expectations.



## Key Responsibilities



### SEO Strategy & Execution



* Perform keyword research and keyword analysis for client websites, service pages, blogs, local SEO pages, landing pages, and content strategies.

* Identify ranking opportunities based on search volume, keyword difficulty, user intent, competitor gaps, and business value.

* Create keyword maps and content recommendations for website pages, blogs, service pages, city pages, and industry pages.

* Support on-page SEO improvements, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, URL structure, image alt text, and content optimization.

* Review website content and provide recommendations to improve rankings, user experience, and organic visibility.

* Help develop SEO strategies that support lead generation, local visibility, brand awareness, and long-term organic growth.



### AI SEO, Generative Search & Answer Engine Optimization



* Stay informed on new methods used to rank and appear in AI-powered search experiences.

* Support optimization for generative search, AI overviews, answer engines, and AI assistant-style search results.

* Research how businesses can improve visibility across AI-driven discovery platforms.

* Help structure content so it is easier for search engines and AI systems to understand, summarize, and reference.

* Recommend content formats that support answer engine optimization, including FAQs, direct-answer sections, entity-based content, comparison content, service explanations, and structured data.

* Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools to support research, content outlines, optimization recommendations, reporting, and workflow efficiency.

* Review AI-assisted work carefully for accuracy, quality, and SEO value.



### Technical SEO



* Conduct technical SEO audits using tools such as Screaming Frog, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and other SEO platforms.

* Identify and document technical issues such as crawl errors, indexation problems, broken links, redirect issues, duplicate content, thin content, missing metadata, page speed concerns, sitemap issues, robots.txt problems, and canonicalization issues.

* Review website architecture, internal linking, crawlability, and indexability.

* Support schema markup recommendations and implementation planning.

* Help test and validate schema implementations using appropriate tools.

* Work with website developers or internal tea
mbers to communicate technical SEO updates clearly.

* Monitor website health and flag issues that may impact rankings, traffic, or search visibility.



### Analytics, Tracking & Reporting



* Use Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Bing Webmaster Tools, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other reporting tools to monitor SEO performance.

* Help build, update, and maintain SEO report dashboards.

* Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, impressions, clicks, backlinks, conversions, indexing status, and other SEO KPIs.

* Use Google Sheets and Google Docs to organize research, audits, reports, notes, and client deliverables.

* Prepare written summaries explaining SEO performance, completed work, opportunities, and recommended next steps.

* Support draft
s, reporting notes, revision notes, dashboard updates, and internal project documentation.

* Ensure reports are accurate, organized, and ready for internal review before delivery.



### Backlink Analysis & Link Building



* Conduct backlink analysis using Ahrefs, SEMrush, and other backlink tools.

* Review competitor backlink profiles to identify link-building opportunities.

* Identify toxic, low-quality, or suspicious backlinks when needed.

* Support backlink-building campaigns through research, prospecting, outreach preparation, and relationship-building opportunities.

* Help create backlink notes, outreach lists, partnership opportunities, and link acquisition recommendations.

* Understand how customer relationships, partnerships, vendors, directories, associations, guest content, sponsorships, and local business connections can support backlink building.

* Track backlink progress and document new, lost, or high-value links.



### Tool Expertise



The ideal candidate should have experience with, or strong working knowledge of:



* SEMrush

* Ahrefs

* Screaming Frog

* Google Tag Manager

* Google Analytics

* Google Search Console

* Bing Webmaster Tools

* Google Sheets

* Google Docs

* ChatGPT

* Claude

* ClickUp or similar project management systems



The candidate should be comfortable learning new tools as SEO, AI search, analytics, and reporting workflows continue to evolve.



### Project Management & Organization



* Use ClickUp or similar project management systems to manage tasks, deadlines, priorities, updates, and deliverables.

* Handle a large caseload of SEO projects across multiple clients and internal initiatives.

* Keep tasks updated consistently with progress notes, blockers, completed work, and next steps.

* Attend daily start-of-day calls to review priorities, active work, deadlines, and current tasks.

* Communicate clearly when work is completed, delayed, blocked, or ready for review.

* Manage multiple projects at once without losing track of details, instructions, or deadlines.

* Follow internal SEO processes, documentation standards, naming conventions, and project workflows.

* Ask thoughtful questions when instructions are unclear and provide proactive updates when priorities shift.



## Client Deliverable Support



Although this role is not client-facing through phone or video calls, it will involve preparing and supporting client deliverables such as:



* SEO dashboards.

* Keyword research documents.

* Technical SEO audits.

* Backlink analysis summaries.

* Revision notes.

* Draft
s.

* Monthly SEO report notes.

* Website optimization recommendations.

* Schema recommendations.

* AI SEO and answer engine optimization recommendations.

* Competitor research summaries.

* Internal project updates.

* Content optimization notes.

* Implementation checklists.

* Screenshots, examples, and documentation when needed.



## Required Skills & Experience



* Experience working in SEO, digital marketing, organic search, or website optimization.

* Strong understanding of keyword research, search intent, competitor analysis, and on-page SEO.

* Experience using SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.

* Understanding of technical SEO, including crawlability, indexation, redirects, canonicals, sitemaps, robots.txt, metadata, internal linking, and site structure.

* Experience with backlink analysis and link-building research.

* Familiarity with schema markup and structured data recommendations.

* Ability to use Google Sheets and Google Docs for reporting, research, documentation, and organization.

* Comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude, and AI tools to support SEO workflows.

* Understanding of AI SEO, generative search, and answer engine optimization trends.

* Ability to manage multiple SEO projects and deadlines at once.

* Strong written communication skills.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to provide consistent project updates without needing constant reminders.

* Comfortable working in ClickUp or another project management platform.

* Ability to follow instructions, document work clearly, and revise deliverables based on feedback.



## Preferred Skills



* Experience working for a marketing agency, SEO agency, web design agency, or digital growth team.

* Experience with local SEO for service-based businesses.

* Experience optimizing service pages, city pages, location pages, blogs, and landing pages.

* Experience with Looker Studio or SEO dashboard tools.

* Experience with WordPress, Elementor, Webflow, Shopify, Wix, or Squarespace.

* Basic HTML knowledge.

* Experience creating schema markup for local businesses, services, FAQs, articles, products, reviews, or organizations.

* Experience with conversion tracking and event setup through Google Tag Manager.

* Experience preparing SEO reports for internal or client review.

* Experience researching AI search visibility, entity SEO, topical authority, and answer engine optimization.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who understands SEO deeply enough to identify problems, explain opportunities, and complete detailed research without needing constant supervision. They should be highly organized, comfortable working across multiple client projects, and able to provide clear written updates on progress, blockers, and next steps.



This person should enjoy analyzing websites, finding ranking opportunities, reviewing competitors, building SEO reports, and staying current with changes in Google search, Bing search, AI-powered search, and generative answer engines.



They do not need to speak with clients on calls, but they should understand that their work directly supports client deliverables. Their reports, notes, audits, and recommendations should be clear, professional, and ready for internal review.



## Daily Expectations



* Attend daily start-of-day calls to review priorities and current tasks.

* Check ClickUp or the assigned project management system regularly.

* Update tasks with progress, blockers, completed work, and next steps.

* Work on keyword research, technical SEO audits, backlink analysis, dashboards, reports, content optimization, and SEO implementation notes.

* Use SEO tools and AI tools consistently to improve speed, quality, and workflow.

* Prepare client deliverables such as dashboards, draft
s, revision notes, audit notes, and project updates.

* Communicate clearly when something is completed, delayed, blocked, or needs review.



## Success in This Role Looks Like



* SEO tasks are completed accurately, clearly, and on time.

* ClickUp tasks are consistently updated.

* Internal tea
mbers always know the status of assigned SEO projects.

* Keyword research, audits, reports, and recommendations are organized and useful.

* Technical SEO issues are identified and documented clearly.

* Backlink opportunities are researched and tracked properly.

* AI SEO and answer engine optimization methods are regularly considered in SEO recommendations.

* Client deliverables are polished, professional, and ready for review.

* The person can manage a large caseload without losing track of details.

* Daily communication is clear, reliable, and helpful.

* Work quality improves over time as the person learns Atmospheric Thinking’s systems and expectations.



## Work Style



This role is best for someone who is:



* Detail-oriented.

* Analytical.

* Organized.

* Curious about search changes and AI search.

* Comfortable with SEO tools and data.

* Strong at written communication.

* Comfortable with fast-moving projects.

* Able to manage multiple priorities.

* Reliable with updates and deadlines.

* Open to feedback.

* Comfortable using AI tools responsibly.

* Able to work independently after receiving direction.



## Summary



The **SEO & AI Search Optimization Specialist** at Atmospheric Thinking will support traditional SEO, technical SEO, backlink analysis, reporting, schema recommendations, AI search optimization, and client deliverable preparation. This role requires strong tool knowledge, attention to detail, project management skills, and the ability to manage a high-volume SEO workload with clear and consistent communication.

description:
Sales Operations Assistant (Remote)



About Fitribe

Fitribe is an online health and fitness coaching company helping women over 40 lose weight and keep it off without extreme dieting.

We are growing and are looking for a highly organised and detail-focused Sales Operations Assistant to help keep our revenue systems clean, accurate, and controlled.



This is not a basic admin role.



This role is suited to someone who thrives on organisation, enjoys working with numbers and trackers, possesses a creative eye for basic design/social media management, and takes pride in making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Position Details

* Role: Sales Operations Assistant

* Hours: 20 hours per week (Note: May transition to 40 hours per week)

* Location: Remote Contractor Role

* Reports To: Sales & Client Recovery Consultant



Main Outcome

Your primary responsibility is to keep our sales, recovery, referral, re-sign, commission, PayRight conversion, and CRM tracking systems accurate and up to date, while supporting the team with essential social media and asset creation needs.

Your job is to ensure the right information and assets are visible, correct, and actioned on time so the business can operate efficiently and make informed decisions.



Key Responsibilities

* Sales and setter scorecard management

* Sales tracker updates and maintenance

* Tracking booked calls, show rates, no-shows, closes, cash collected, and payment types

* Commission tracking preparation

* Referral and re-sign tracker management

* PayRight conversion tracker updates

* CRM note audits and checks

* Following up on missing information and incomplete data

* Identifying and reporting revenue-risk client issues

* Creating and updating basic visual assets using Canva

* Assisting with daily social media management, scheduling, or basic engagement coordination



What You Will Not Own

* Sales calls / Save calls

* Coaching decisions

* Pricing decisions

* Team management



Your role is to keep the systems clean, the data accurate, and the social platforms supported so the right people can make the right decisions.



You're a Strong Fit If You...

* Are extremely organised and notice details others often miss

* Love clean spreadsheets, accurate reporting, and are confident using Google Sheets

* Possess a strong working knowledge of Canva and understand social media best practices

* Are comfortable following up on missing information

* Can follow processes without constant reminders and communicate clearly/professionally

* Take ownership when things are messy

* Understand that missed notes, incorrect data, and missed follow-ups can directly impact revenue

* Work well independently and do not require micromanagement



You're Probably Not a Fit If You...

* Need constant reminders to complete tasks

* Avoid numbers, reporting, or digital platforms

* Frequently miss small details or wait for others to chase you

* Dislike spreadsheets, trackers, data entry, or routine administrative upkeep

* Have no experience or interest in creative tools like Canva or social media management

* Are looking for a simple admin role

* Are uncomfortable being held to clear standards and KPIs



Tools We Use

* Google Sheets

* Canva

* Social Media Platforms (Instagram,
, etc.)

* Slack & Asana

* GoHighLevel (or similar CRM platforms)

* Stripe & PayRight



Success in Your First 30 Days

* Scorecards and trackers are updated daily and submitted on time

* Missing data and revenue-risk issues are identified and flagged quickly

* Commission, referral, re-sign, and PayRight tracking are accurately maintained

* CRM note gaps are identified and addressed

* Canva assets and social media tasks are delivered consistently and on schedule

* The sales and marketing team has cleaner, more reliable support



How to Apply

1. Short Introduction – Tell us why you believe you're a strong fit for this role.

2. Relevant Experience – Outline your experience with Google Sheets, CRM systems, sales administration, tracking/reporting, as well as your experience with Canva and social media management.

3. Availability – Provide your current availability and confirm your flexibility should this role transition to 40 hours per week.

4. Loom Video (Maximum 3 Minutes)?“Tell us about a time you helped clean up, organise, or improve a messy admin, sales, tracking, reporting, or operations system. What was the problem, what did you do, and what improved?”

5. Written Response?“If you were checking our sales tracker daily, what are the first five things you would look for to make sure nothing important was missed?”



[!IMPORTANT] Applications that do not include both the Loom video and written response will not be reviewed.

To show you've read the full job post, please start your application with: “Clean data protects revenue.”

About the Shop

We're a small but growing CNC machine shop. Right now it's a tight team — the owner is both the lead machinist and the person fielding every phone call,
, and quote request. That's about to change.



We're looking for our first dedicated Virtual Assistant to take over the admin side of the business completely, so the owner can get back on the floor doing what he does best: running machines. This is a foundational hire — as the shop adds more machinists, your role grows with it. You won't be one of many VAs lost in a big team; you'll be the backbone of how this shop runs day to day.



If you've worked in a machine shop, manufacturing, or fabrication environment before — even better. You'll already understand the language, the urgency, and what "the customer needs this part by Friday" actually means.



What You'll Be Doing

Client Communication



Answer incoming phone calls from clients (yes, real phone calls — comfort and confidence on the phone is a must)

Make outbound calls when needed (quote follow-ups, scheduling, payment reminders)

Manage the
 inbox: respond to client inquiries, route questions, keep things from falling through the cracks

Quoting & Sales Support



Manage incoming quote requests and keep the quoting pipeline organized

Follow up with prospects who haven't responded to a quote

Track quote status from "sent" to "won/lost" so nothing goes stale

Accounts Receivable / Payment Follow-Up



Send polite, professional payment reminder
s and calls to clients with outstanding invoices

Keep a simple log of who's been contacted and when

Office & Task Management



Keep the shop's task boards (Trello/Notion) up to date and organized

Manage the owner's inbox and calendar so he's not buried in admin between machine cycles

General office admin: filing, data entry, document organization, ordering supplies, whatever keeps the shop running smoothly

Communicate daily with the owner via Slack for updates, questions, and priorities

What We're Looking For

Required:



Strong professional English — written and spoken. You don't need a "perfect" accent, but clients need to understand you clearly and you need to sound confident and competent on the phone

Comfortable and confident making/answering phone calls to US clients — this is a core part of the job, not occasional

Solid experience as a Virtual Assistant or office admin (2+ years preferred)

Proficient with Outlook 
/calendar), Slack, Trello, and Notion — or able to pick these up fast

Highly organized self-starter — you'll often be managing your own priority list with light supervision

Reliable internet connection, backup power/internet solution, and a quiet space for calls

Available to work US Pacific business hours, full-time

Strongly Preferred:



Previous experience as an office admin, customer service rep, or VA for a machine shop, fabrication shop, manufacturing company, or similar industrial/technical business

Familiarity with manufacturing terms (tolerances, materials, lead times, quotes/POs) — or genuine willingness to learn them quickly

Experience handling accounts receivable or payment follow-up communications

Experience managing a quoting or sales pipeline

Why This Role

You're the first VA hire — you'll help shape how the admin side of this business runs as it scales, not just follow a rigid playbook

Real growth path — as the shop adds machinists and volume increases, your responsibilities (and pay) grow with it. This isn't a static, capped role

Direct line to the owner — no layers of management, no corporate bureaucracy. You'll work closely with the person making the decisions

Stability — this is a long-term position for the right person, not a short-term project

How to Apply

Please apply with the following so we can move quickly:



A short cover message telling us about your experience — specifically mention if you've worked in a machine shop, manufacturing, or industrial business before

description:
We are a fast-growing eCommerce dropshipping company selling across multiple EU markets. We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Product Researcher to find our next winning products before the market gets saturated. You will spend your days digging through competitor ads, analysing what is working, downloading and documenting winning creatives, and feeding everything into our research dashboard. You will work closely with the Operations Manager, who will take your research and turn it into live campaigns.

This is not a guessing-game role. We use real data from ad spy tools and structured analysis. If you love the thrill of finding a winning product before everyone else does, this role is for you.



What you will do

Daily ad research

• Search
 Ad Library, Minea, and Adspy daily to identify trending and high-spend ads in our niche

• Filter by engagement, run time, and reach to find ads that are genuinely scaling — not just boosted

• Identify the product, the angle, and the hook used in each winning ad

• Track new entrants and monitor what established competitors are testing



Competitor analysis

• Visit competitor stores to document pricing, upsells, bundle offers, and guarantee language

• Go through competitor funnels end-to-end and document the full flow with screenshots

• Identify gaps in competitor positioning that we can exploit with our own angle

• Note shipping times, product reviews, and customer complaints to find improvement opportunities



Ad download and dashboard entry

• Download winning competitor video and image ads and save them in the shared drive, organised by product

• Log every winning ad into the research dashboard: product name, ad link, ad spend estimate, hook, angle, target market, and your commentary

• Tag each entry clearly so the Operations Manager and Media Buyer can filter and use it instantly

• Keep the dashboard clean and up to date — no orphaned entries, no missing fields



Product reporting

• Submit 3–5 researched product opportunities per week in our standard product report format

title: Senior Amazon PPC Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Decolure is a US-based e-commerce company generating $18M+ annually on Amazon, with expanding presence on TikTok Shop and DTC Shopify. We operate 5 private label brands with 20+ active products across the portfolio.

What makes us different: we're building one of the most data-driven operations in the private label space. Our team uses advanced analytics, AI-powered operational agents, custom data pipelines, and structured decision frameworks to manage every aspect of the business , from keyword-level PPC decisions to inventory forecasting to competitive intelligence. This isn't a company where you'll be making gut calls. Every decision is backed by data, and every action plan has measurable outcomes.

We're a 27-person distributed team across the world. We operate in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment where ownership and accountability matter more than hours logged.



THE ROLE

We're hiring a Senior PPC Manager (Lead) to own the entire Amazon advertising function across our portfolio — 5 brands, 27+ products, and $180K+/month in ad spend. This is a leadership role: you will architect campaign strategy, lead the Amazon PPC team (currently 2 specialists), and drive measurable profitability improvements.

You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with Brand Managers and Launch Managers. The right candidate brings deep Amazon PPC expertise, financial discipline, and the ability to translate brand-level performance goals into campaign-level execution.

This is not a button-pushing role. We expect you to think in terms of profitability — not just ACOS — and to own the relationship between advertising spend, organic growth, and overall product economics.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Campaign Architecture & Execution

Design and manage campaign structures across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands (including Video), and Sponsored Display for the full portfolio

Structure campaigns by clear objectives — ranking, market share, defensive, conquesting, conversions, discovery, and branded

Maintain logical, consistent naming conventions across all campaigns

Optimize bids and placements using data — understand when and why to use Top-of-Search modifiers, Rest-of-Search adjustments, and Product Page placements

Manage campaign automation tools (we use Scale Insights) with the judgment to know when manual intervention is needed



Performance & Profitability Management

Own portfolio-level TACoS and per-product ACOS targets, always relative to break-even ACOS (not arbitrary fixed percentages)

Run regular PPC performance reviews — identify waste, find scaling opportunities, and optimize toward profitability

Understand how PPC performance connects to overall product economics — ad spend should drive profitable growth, not just revenue

Produce clear, concise performance reports for leadership



Brand Management ? PPC Coordination

Work closely with Brand Managers to align advertising tactics with brand performance goals

When brand-level analysis identifies specific performance issues (e.g., strong conversion but low visibility on key search terms), translate those findings into concrete PPC actions

Participate in regular cross-functional syncs to ensure PPC strategy supports — not conflicts with — broader brand strategy



Team Leadership

Lead, develop, and hold accountable 2 PPC specialists

Set weekly priorities, review work quality, and provide coaching

Own the PPC department's quarterly goals and bi-weekly sprint commitments

Build processes and guardrails that prevent costly mistakes (bid errors, budget overruns, campaign misconfigurations)



New Product Launch Support

Build and manage campaign structures for new product launches — understand that launch-phase PPC requires different targets, budgets, and patience than maintenance-phase products

Coordinate with Launch Managers on performance monitoring and budget phasing as products progress through early traction into sustainable organic growth

Know when a launch campaign is working, when it needs adjustment, and when to escalate



QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

Must Have

5+ years managing Amazon PPC campaigns (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display)

Proven experience managing $50K+/month in ad spend across multiple brands or products simultaneously

Deep understanding of ACOS, TACoS, break-even ACOS, and how advertising connects to product-level profitability

Experience structuring campaigns by objective — not just match type

Track record of improving advertising efficiency while maintaining or growing revenue

Team leadership experience — managing at least 1-2 PPC specialists or analysts

Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills for data analysis and reporting

Fluent English communication (written and verbal) — daily async coordination with US-based CEO



Strong Preference

Experience with Scale Insights, Pacvue, or equivalent PPC automation tools

Experience in the bedding, home textiles, or home & kitchen category on Amazon

Familiarity with search term analysis, keyword grouping, and search volume-weighted performance aggregation

Experience with Helium 10, Data Dive, or similar Amazon research tools

Understanding of placement modifiers (Top-of-Search, Rest-of-Search, Product Pages) and when to use them strategically

Experience working with Amazon Brand Analytics or Search Query Performance data



Nice to Have

Experience with Amazon DSP or Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC)

Experience with Walmart Connect or TikTok Shop advertising

Background in private label (different strategic approach than reselling or wholesale)

Multi-marketplace experience (US, CA, UK, EU)



WORKING CONDITIONS

100% remote — work from anywhere

Full-time (40 hours/week) with flexibility on daily schedule

Must overlap with US Eastern Time business hours for at least 4 hours daily (core hours: 10 AM – 2 PM EST recommended)

Company operates on a synchronized 2-week sprint cadence across all departments

Tools provided: Seller Central access, Scale Insights, Helium 10, Data Dive, SellerBoard



WHAT YOU'LL GET

Competitive salary based on experience

Fully remote position. Work from anywhere

Direct access to the CEO. Your ideas and analysis reach the decision-maker, not a middle manager

Advanced tooling and infrastructure, including AI-powered analytics, custom dashboards, and automated reporting that let you focus on strategy instead of data entry

A team that values data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement

Opportunities for growth as the company expands into new marketplaces and channels

Employee discounts on Decolure products



HOW TO APPLY

Send your cover letter and CV to 
 using this subject line format:

Full Name - Country - Senior PPC Manager - Source

Applications that do not follow this subject line format will not be processed.

title: Ecommerce Design Director
description:
JOB TITLE: Ecommerce Design Director

LOCATION: Remote

EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full Time



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for a Ecommerce Design Director who can take ownership of an in-house design department and combine a high creative bar with the operational push to ship on time. You'll lead and direct two full-time designers and partner with a branding consultant — but you won't be the one designing. Your job is to hold the standard, push projects forward, and turn a talented but slow-moving team into a fluid creative engine.

If you think in terms of e-commerce conversion (not just brand aesthetic), if you've felt the frustration of design projects that drift instead of ship, and if you're already fluent in AI-augmented design workflows — keep reading.



ABOUT US

Decolure is a US-based e-commerce company generating $18M+ annually on Amazon, with expanding presence on TikTok Shop and DTC Shopify. We operate 5 private label brands with 20+ active products across the portfolio.

What makes us different: we're building one of the most data-driven operations in the private label space. Our team uses advanced analytics, AI-powered operational agents, custom data pipelines, and structured decision frameworks to manage every aspect of the business , from keyword-level PPC decisions to inventory forecasting to competitive intelligence. This isn't a company where you'll be making gut calls. Every decision is backed by data, and every action plan has measurable outcomes.

We're a 27-person distributed team across the world. We operate in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment where ownership and accountability matter more than hours logged.



THE ROLE

As Ecommerce Design Director, you'll own the performance of the design department. You report directly to the CEO and lead two full-time designers, with a branding consultant as a dotted-line partner.

The role is purely management — you'll be running 1:1s, giving creative feedback, holding the quality bar, and driving deadlines. You'll partner closely with brand management to translate listing performance gaps into creative briefs, and you'll work with product R&D on launch creative.

The biggest gap on the team today is operational push — talented people, but projects drift. Your first 90 days will be about taking that problem off our plate so the CEO can step out of design reviews entirely until final approval.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Department Leadership & Ownership

Take full ownership of the design department — lead 1:1s with each designer, become their primary contact, and drive every active project to completion

Audit the full creative scope in your first 30 days, identify the top gaps, and ship a prioritized improvement plan

Hold a high creative standard across every deliverable — main images, A+ content, packaging — by giving pointed, specific feedback rather than generic critique

Replace upper management as the design quality gate. By 90 days, leadership involvement should drop to final approval only



Process Improvement & Systems Thinking

Build durable solutions to recurring problems — not weekly triage. Every issue should be fixed once with a process change that prevents recurrence

Ship measurable process improvements within 60 days (lead time targets, revision-count targets, brief quality, review cadence)

Hit and maintain the design KPIs: on-time delivery and low revision counts on every active project

Use the in-house Design module (project workspaces, daily audits, briefs, creative priority tab) as your operating system — and improve the parts that aren't working



Cross-Functional Creative Direction

Partner with brand management to translate listing performance gaps (CTR, CVR, organic share) into specific creative briefs that fix the underlying issue

Collaborate with product R&D on launch creative ??? packaging, main images, A+ content — for new product introductions

Push back on creative direction from upper management when you have a strong opinion grounded in e-commerce conversion logic. We want a creative expert, not an order-taker

Coordinate with the branding consultant on brand identity work that touches the broader design portfolio



AI-Augmented Design Operations

Actively research the latest design and AI-design principles and bring them into the team's workflow

Direct the team's use of AI image tools (Midjourney, Nano Banana / Gemini Image, FLUX, or comparable) — including prompt construction, tool selection, and quality control

Use the in-house AI image generation pipeline and creative priority tab to proactively identify and improve underperforming creative

Treat AI as the leverage strategy, not a threat — designer headcount grows slowly because AI substantially expands capacity, and we need a leader who runs toward that, not away from it



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required Experience

5–10 years of total design experience, with at least 2 years managing other designers (this is not a first-management role)

Hands-on Amazon creative ownership — main images, A+ content, packaging — for at least one $10M+/year private-label brand

Proven e-commerce creative fluency: you can look at a main image and articulate why it will win or lose CTR, not just whether it's pretty

Demonstrated ability to drive design projects to on-time completion with low revision counts — references on this are essential

Systems thinking for design operations: examples of process improvements you've built that solved a recurring problem durably

Active AI fluency in your daily workflow — comfort with ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney (or comparable AI image tools), and a track record of integrating AI into a design team

Expert in Figma; fluent in ClickUp and Slack from day one (no ramp-up time on the basics)

Experience as a primary cross-functional partner with brand management or marketing — not just receiving briefs, but co-creating them from listing performance data



Preferred Experience

Direct experience with premium bedding / home textiles brands (Decolure, Sleephoria, Bamboo Reserve, CooLinens, or comparable)

Working knowledge of Claude specifically — our internal stack is heavily Claude-based (skills, agents, dashboards)

Experience operating inside an AI-agent-augmented organization with custom internal dashboards and audits

Named expertise with specific AI image tools (Midjourney, Nano Banana / Gemini Image, FLUX) — including prompt engineering

TikTok Shop and DTC Shopify creative experience for the channel-expansion roadmap



WHO YOU ARE

You're a driver, not a curator. You push projects forward instead of letting them drift. You've felt the frustration of careful leadership that ships nothing, and you don't want to be that person

You're a systems thinker who fixes problems once. When you see the same issue twice, you don't just dispatch the triage — you build the durable solution that prevents the third occurrence

You have a craft eye and strong opinions. You're the creative expert in the room, fluent enough in e-commerce design to give pointed, specific feedback and push back on weak work — not just say 'looks good' or 'try again'

You're eager to learn, not threatened by it. You don't need to walk in already knowing our brands or stack — but you do need to be hungry to ramp on AI tools, internal systems, and category nuances. AI is core leverage in this role, and we want a leader who runs toward it

You communicate clearly in writing. Most of our team coordination is async via Slack and in-app tools. You can write a brief that a designer can execute without a meeting



WHAT YOU'LL GET

Competitive salary based on experience

Fully remote position — work from anywhere with strong English fluency and overlap with US working hours

Direct access to the CEO via weekly 1:1s and ad-hoc syncs

An agent-augmented operations stack — AI-powered internal agents, custom dashboards, and in-house tooling that lets you focus on direction instead of admin

Ownership of a design department where the systems improvements you build actually stick

Opportunities for growth as the company expands into new channels and categories

A team that values durable systems, data-backed decisions, and pushing creative work forward



WHAT A TYPICAL WEEK LOOKS LIKE

Monday: Review the weekend's design audit report. Scan the active project board in the in-house Design module — flag any project that's drifted on lead time or stacked up revisions. Set the week's priorities with each designer in 1:1s. Open the creative priority tab to see which products are flagged for creative improvement and d
 what to add to the active queue.

Tuesday to Thursday:Run design reviews on active projects — give pointed feedback, approve or send back, never just rubber-stamp. Partner with brand management on creative briefs for newly flagged underperforming listings. Coordinate with product R&D on launch creative. Push process improvements forward — every week, at least one durable systems fix should ship. Spend time researching AI-design developments and integrating them into team workflows.

Friday: Weekly 1:1 with the CEO. Review week's wins, blockers, and KPI movement (lead times, revision counts, on-time delivery). Confirm the next week's brief queue with brand management. Update the daily audit response cycle and clear any open items so the team starts Monday clean.



HOW TO APPLY

 using this subject line format:

Full Name - Country - Design Director - Source

Applications that do not follow this subject line format will not be processed.

title: Product Development Lead
description:
ABOUT US

Decolure is a US-based e-commerce company generating $18M+ annually on Amazon, with expanding presence on TikTok Shop and DTC Shopify. We operate 5 private label brands with 20+ active products across the portfolio.

What makes us different: we're building one of the most data-driven operations in the private label space. Our team uses advanced analytics, AI-powered operational agents, custom data pipelines, and structured decision frameworks to manage every aspect of the business , from keyword-level PPC decisions to inventory forecasting to competitive intelligence. This isn't a company where you'll be making gut calls. Every decision is backed by data, and every action plan has measurable outcomes.

We're a 27-person distributed team across the world. We operate in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment where ownership and accountability matter more than hours logged.



THE ROLE

We're hiring a Product Development Lead to be the single owner of what we launch and why. This is the strategic-creative seat that turns raw market signal, customer voice, and the competitive landscape into a differentiated product concept brief — the document that our research, sourcing, brand management, and design teams all build against.

To be clear about what this role is not: you won't run the product research scoring process, manage the catalog or listing operations, write listing copy, produce creative assets, or negotiate with manufacturers. Dedicated specialists own each of those. Your job is to walk into a category that research has already validated and produce the differentiated concept brief — positioning, USP architecture, naming, size and variation mix, packaging direction, listing angle, and brand voice — that turns "another bedding product" into something obviously distinct from the closest competitors.

The role is roughly 60?ep concept work, 25% cross-functional partnership and decision-making, and 15% continuous-improvement direction on existing products. If your passion is manufacturing, design execution, or running ads, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive on synthesizing disparate signals into a sharp, defensible product offer — and then watching that brief ship through a fast-moving execution team — read on.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Concept Briefs for New Launches (?60% of your time)

Take the handoff once a category is validated by research, and produce the locked concept brief before sourcing begins.

Define the differentiated offer: USP architecture, positioning, naming, size and variation mix, packaging direction, listing angle, brand voice, and a clear statement of what the concept is not.

Pull and synthesize primary research — competitor review corpora, competitor listings, search-query data, trend signals, and internal performance patterns.

Build and defend the differentiation hypothesis with written evidence, not opinion.

Run each locked brief through a structured review with brand management, design, and sourcing before handoff.

Hold the line on commoditized concept submissions, escalating only when there's a genuine dispute.



Cross-Functional Partnership & Decision-Making (?25% of your time)

Weekly sync with the product research team on pipeline scoring and category prioritization.

Weekly sync with the catalog manager on listing-strategy handoff and variation-expansion decisions.

Weekly sync with the creative director on visual identity briefs and concept-to-creative translation.

Bi-weekly sync with brand management on existing-product performance signals that may call for re-conceptualization.

As-needed coordination with sourcing on capability constraints and substitution decisions.

D
 which existing products are candidates for re-concept versus incremental tuning, and brief the work.

Escalate to the CEO only what genuinely requires it — product kills, major positioning shifts, brand-architecture moves. You own everything below that line.



Cross-Functional Coordination

Collaborate with PPC specialists on campaign strategy, bid optimization, and budget allocation aligned with brand-level goals

Work with the inventory and logistics team to manage DOS (Days of Supply), prevent stockouts on hero SKUs, and mitigate LTSF (Long-Term Storage Fee) exposure

Coordinate with product development on listing improvements, packaging changes, and product enhancements driven by review analysis and competitive gaps

Partner with the creative team on A+ content, image optimization, and video content development

Communicate action plans with clear ownership, deadlines, and success metrics. No open-ended initiatives



Continuous-Improvement Direction (?15% of your time)

Identify existing products whose performance has plateaued, and propose re-conceptualization rather than endless incremental tuning.

Build the re-concept brief for relaunch when the concept — not the execution — is the bottleneck.

Document the concept patterns that win and lose, turning the work into institutional memory rather than personal craft.

Maintain a concept library and a competitive-concept teardown archive.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required Experience

6+ years total in product strategy, product marketing, product innovation, or category management at private-label or own-brand e-commerce companies.

At least 3 years specifically in private-label e-commerce, consumer brand strategy, or category management. (Purely agency-side experience won't be a fit for this role.)

Direct experience building product concepts that went to manufacture and launch — you'll be asked to reference launched products whose concept you owned.

A demonstrated ability to read competitive landscapes and produce differentiated angles. We'll ask for written examples.

Strong writing skills — your output is briefs, not pitches. We test this directly in the skills assessment.

Deep comfort reading Amazon listings, customer review corpora, competitor ASINs, and search-query data, and translating all of it into a concept brief.

Genuine AI fluency in your daily workflow — comfort with tools like ChatGPT and Claude, AI image tools for visual concepting, and a track record of integrating AI into a real research workflow.

Fluent written and verbal English. This is a CEO-facing role, and writing is the core unit of work.

Strong project-management discipline and comfort with async-first written communication (we use tools such as ClickUp, Notion, and Slack).

Proven leadership and team management experience - you’ll own cross-functional decisions from day one, and this seat is built to grow into leading a team.



Strong Preferences

Experience with bedding, sleep, home textiles, or an analogous high-subjectivity category (apparel, beauty, supplements, premium home goods).

Experience at a private-label brand that scaled meaningfully (for example, from $5M to $50M+ in annual revenue) with you owning concept work for at least three launched products.

A brand-naming portfolio — three or more launched product or line names you originated, with the rationale behind them.

Physical packaging concept experience, not just digital.

Working knowledge of Amazon's brand-content surfaces (Brand Story, A+ and Premium A+ content) as places a concept gets expressed.





Nice to Have

Direct knowledge of bedding construction: weave types, GSM math, fabric blends, color-trend cycles.

Comfort reading search-query-performance data and ranking reports and translating them into concept-level implications.

TikTok Shop concept-work experience.

A background as a brand manager or senior product marketer who moved into pure concept and innovation work.



WHAT YOU'LL GET

Competitive salary based on experience

A fully built system to walk into: an established product research pipeline and scoring framework, a launch pipeline already in flight, master keyword lists, a competitive-intelligence database, and detailed per-product source-of-truth files. You inherit structure, not a blank page.

An AI research and synthesis partner from day one: AI-powered operational tools that deliver daily analytics, weekly summaries, competitor intel, listing-performance signals, and structured frameworks for concept evaluation.

A 90-day onboarding playbook to ramp from zero context to shipping locked concept briefs.

Direct CEO access for decisions above your authority level — a clear escalation path with no middle-management bureaucracy.

A growing company: we're expanding from Amazon into TikTok Shop and early-stage DTC Shopify, opening new categories and channels.

A clear growth path: as the portfolio scales, this role can evolve into Head of Product Strategy, leading a team of researcher-strategists.

Fully remote, with employee discounts across our brands. Work from anywhere with strong English fluency and meaningful overlap with US working hours.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your cover letter and CV to 
 using this subject line format:

Full Name - Country - Product Development Lead - Source

(e.g., Jane Doe - United States - Product Development Lead - LinkedIn)



Applications that do not follow this subject line format will not be processed.

title: Principal Full Stack Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are an established enterprise e-commerce business looking for a Principal Full Stack Engineer to take ownership of our platform architecture, hosting infrastructure, and engineering direction. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can write production code, design systems end-to-end, and operate the underlying cloud infrastructure with confidence.

You will be the sole engineer on the platform initially, reporting directly to the business owner. You will be responsible for the technical health of the platform end-to-end: codebase quality, performance, scalability, security, and the production environment that runs it all. As the business grows, you will help define how the engineering function is built out around you — including hiring decisions and the standards future engineers will work to.





TECH STACK

You will be working primarily with the following technologies. Deep, demonstrable experience across this stack is required — not familiarity, but production-grade fluency.

- Backend: PHP / CodeIgniter

- Frontend: Bootstrap, Node.js

- Database: MySQL

- Hosting: Google Compute Engine (application), Google Cloud SQL (database)

- Web Server: NGINX (configuration, tuning, and troubleshooting)

- Payments: Braintree





WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the architecture and ongoing evolution of our CodeIgniter-based e-commerce platform.

- Design, build, and maintain features across the full stack — from MySQL schema and CodeIgniter controllers through to Bootstrap-driven UI and Node.js components.

- Configure, secure, and optimize our hosting environment on Google Compute Engine and Google Cloud SQL.

- Write and maintain NGINX configurations: virtual hosts, SSL/TLS, reverse proxying, caching, rate limiting, and performance tuning.

- Diagnose production issues across the full stack — application code, database, web server, and infrastructure.

- Set the engineering standards and conventions that will scale as the team grows around you.

- Partner with leadership on technical roadmap, scaling decisions, and platform investments.

- Make pragmatic build-vs-buy and refactor-vs-rewrite decisions with full ownership of the tradeoffs.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



REQUIRED

- 7+ years of professional full-stack engineering experience, with a meaningful portion in PHP / CodeIgniter on production e-commerce or similarly transactional systems.

- Strong MySQL skills — query optimization, indexing strategy, schema design, and replication/backup awareness.

- Production experience with Google Cloud Platform, specifically Compute Engine and Cloud SQL.

- Hands-on NGINX configuration experience — not copy-paste, but the ability to write and reason about configs from scratch.

- Solid Node.js fluency for frontend tooling, backend services, or both.

- Bootstrap proficiency and the ability to deliver clean, responsive, accessible UI without a dedicated designer.

- Payment processor integration experience on production e-commerce systems. Our platform runs on Braintree, so direct Braintree experience is strongly preferred — but solid hands-on experience with a comparable processor (Stripe, Adyen, 
, etc.) is acceptable. We expect fluency with tokenization, vaulting, webhooks, refunds/disputes, and PCI-aware integration patterns regardless of the specific provider.

- Demonstrated ability to operate independently and take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks.





NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with high-traffic e-commerce platforms (cart, checkout, inventory, fulfillment).

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and container orchestration.

- Background in technical leadership, hiring, or running an engineering function.

- Security hardening experience for public-facing web applications.





HOW WE EVALUATE CANDIDATES

We are a lean operation and we hire deliberately. This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role with no other engineers to lean on initially, so we are looking for someone who can operate as a complete technical owner from day one. Candidates who progress past the initial conversation will be asked to complete the technical assessment.



The assessment is designed to mirror the actual work of this role: standing up a real environment, configuring real infrastructure, and shipping a working end-to-end deliverable.



We respect your time. The assessment is scoped to a few hours of focused work by an engineer at this level. We do not ask for unpaid feature work or anything that ships into our production codebase.



COMPENSATION

$2,500/month



SCHEDULE

- PH time but very dynamic type of shcedule

- With OT expected

- Mostly On-Call, with work to do every week with full time pay





HOW TO APPLY

If interested, please apply to this position directly or fill out the following form in order for your application to be considered: 



Good luck!

title: Job Title: Remote User Acquisition (UA) Manager – Performance Marketing Agency
description:
We are a growing digital marketing agency specializing in high-performance paid advertising and growth marketing. We help global brands and mobile applications scale their user base through data-driven strategies. As we expand our international team, we are looking for a highly analytical and results-oriented User Acquisition (UA) Manager from the Philippines to drive our paid traffic channels to the next level.



Job Overview:

As a UA Manager, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing multi-channel paid advertising campaigns to acquire high-quality users at an optimal cost. You will work closely with the creative and data analytics teams to continuously improve campaign performance, scale budgets, and maximize ROAS.



Key Responsibilities:

Campaign Management: Set up, launch, and manage large-scale UA campaigns across major paid channels (primarily
 Ads, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads).



Data Analysis: Monitor, analyze, and report on daily campaign metrics (CPI, CPA, ROAS, LTV, Retention Rate) to make data-driven optimization decisions.



A/B Testing: Design and execute continuous A/B testing strategies for audiences, landing pages, and ad creatives.



Creative Strategy: Collaborate with the design team to brainstorm, brief, and test high-converting video and static ad concepts.



Budget Allocation: Optimize budget distribution across different platforms and target segments to meet and exceed monthly growth targets.



Required Qualifications:

Experience: Minimum 2-3 years of proven experience in User Acquisition, Performance Marketing, or Paid Media management (experience with mobile apps, e-commerce, or lead generation is a strong plus).



Platform Expertise: Deep hands-on experience and solid technical knowledge of
 Ads Manager and Google Ads.



Analytical Skills: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data sets and turn insights into actionable strategies (proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets is required).



Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote environment.



Work Ethic: Highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.



What We Offer:

Competitive monthly salary based on experience and skills.



100% Remote / Work-from-home setup.



Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday).



Opportunities for career growth and skill development in a dynamic agency environment.



How to Apply:

title: SEO Keyword& Backlinking Specialist  (Ahrefs & Strategy Expert)
description:
About Us 



We operate several brands across Australia. We are hiring a specialist to plan and execute safe, measurable backlink acquisition that lifts authority and rankings. We rely heavily on data-driven strategies, so deep experience with industry-standard software is required

.

The Role You will own white-hat link building across multiple domains. Your focus is to ship a practical strategy fast, run consistent outreach, and secure high-quality links at a sustainable velocity. You must bring recent agency experience, expert-level proficiency in Ahrefs, and the ability to conduct commercial keyword research to ensure we are building links to pages that actually drive revenue.



Key Responsibilities



Strategy: Build a 90-day backlink plan per site with targets, anchor approach, and competitor gap analysis.

Keyword Research: Use Ahrefs (Keywords Explorer & Content Gap) to identify high-value commercial keywords and validation metrics (KD, Volume, Traffic Potential) to prioritize which pages need links.

Prospecting: Source and qualify opportunities across guest posts, resource pages, unlinked mentions, and digital PR.

Acquisition: Secure high-quality, relevant placements that support priority pages.

Quality & Risk: Enforce white-hat standards, keep anchors natural, and monitor indexation.

Reporting: Track and report weekly on new referring domains, keyword ranking movements, and overall progress.



What We're Looking For

Essential:

Expert proficiency with Ahrefs (Site Explorer, Content Gap, Keywords Explorer).

Proven ability to perform keyword research that aligns link building with commercial search intent.

Recent agency experience delivering link building for US, UK, or Australian clients.

Proven record securing links that move rankings for commercial pages.

Confident in digital PR style pitching and source-request platforms.

Clear written English suitable for outreach copy.

Solid understanding of E-E-A-T signals, relevance, and risk.



Highly Valued:

Experience with unlinked mention reclamation and brand monitoring.

Demonstrated success earning links to product or service pages, not only blog content.

Basic GA4 and Search Console analysis to connect links to outcomes.

Tools and Platforms Mandatory: Ahrefs (You must be an advanced user). Other: Semrush, Majestic, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, GA4, Pitchbox (or similar).
